Last Minute ESC Opportunity – 2 Spots Available! 
We have 2 open places in our European Solidarity Corps project in Drăgășani, Romania.

📌 Duration: 3–4 months
📌 Starting: Immediately – we welcome volunteers who can arrive as soon as possible
📌 Eligibility: Open to volunteers from any country not requiring a visa to enter Romania

The volunteers will be accommodated in rented apartments in Drăgăşani, Vâlcea County, equipped with bathroom and well-equipped kitchen, 2 participants per room.
Will receive montly allowance, pocket money and transport arrangements according to the ESC program guide.

CV and motivation letter required

EXPERYMENT Science Centre is a modern scientific and educational playground for amateur explorers and the „learning through fun” philosophy followers of all ages. It is an educational institution popularizing science in the form of interactive installations and shows. Its goal is to combine science and fun, and to conduct activities that promote science. ESC volunteers are joining the educational projects team of the Centre. Their task is to support the educational activities in the field of science with actions and ideas.

Volunteer will be provided with monthly Pocket money and tickets for buses in Gdynia to go to work. Volunteer will share a room with 2-3 other volunteers in a rented flat.

Volunteer is obliged to participate in training provided by National Agency (On-arrival training and Mid-term training) as well as trainings run and and organized by supporting organization.

We are looking for volunteers who are communicative, open for new experiences, creative and inventive. The volunteer should be interested in methods of active education, open for people from other countries and cultures and like to co-operate and work in group. S/he should be open-minded to contribute with one’s own creativity and willing to develop his/her personality. How to apply? Candidates interested in taking part in voluntary activity should fill in application form available here: https://cwm.org.pl/wolontariat-miedzynarodowy/543 
The activity shell start in January 2026 and last minimum 6 months.

This project aims to support participants' personal, social, and cultural development. It seeks to provide cultural awareness, social skills, social consciousness, personal growth, educational and career opportunities, and digital competencies. Participants develop themselves and contribute to society. The project offers young people opportunities to help, learn, produce, and grow, fosteang their development into more conscious, responsible, and active individuals.
- Between 18-30,
- ⁠Requires no visa or already have a valid visa
- ⁠With a passport 
- ⁠Female
- ⁠Can start immediately
- ⁠Open to volunteering for 4 months

Within the scope of the project, 5 volunteers who can stay for a minimum of 2 months and a maximum of 6 months will be included in the 2 or 6-month volunteer program of their choice.

The volunteer will be hosted at the Lycée where he/she will carry out various activities. He/she will also participate in the activities of partner associations, depending on his/her interests. He/she will have two main tasks :
- To raise awareness of citizenship and international solidarity issues. He/she will contribute to the preparation and organisation of the Festival of Solidarity, and participate in other events. The volunteer will be able to propose and organise events and work on the construction of educational and communication tools.
- Raising awareness of international mobility among young people, particularly in the context of Erasmus schemes. He/she will support students in their internship projects abroad.
He/she will participate in the functioning of the MDL, the students' association: participation in activities and cultural outings. 
The volunteering will be coordinated by FDMJC22, the ESC coordinating organisation.

The volunteer will be accommodated in a flat, close to the school, in a shared flat with other volunteers in St Brieuc...

Training with the national agency
Training with the coordinating organisation (5 per year) on citizenship, interculturality, commitment and volunteering.

To select the volunteer, our only criterion is his/her motivation, on two levels: the desire to live an intercultural experience and the will to work with young people, without any prerequisite, neither language, nor experience in this field. A certain maturity of the volunteer is desired due to the profile of our young people (22 years old or more).

Kiviõli is a small community in North-East Estonia. In Kiviõli Kindergarten Kannike the volunteer will assist the teachers with activities and initiate some of his/her activities as well. Kindergarten offers a good opportunity for volunteers to help prepare children for school and in cooperation with parents to carry out a good up-bringing and education for children, taking into consideration specific features of each child, interests and principles of family education. Furthermore, we offer a variety of programs for different age groups to ensure a positive experience and the proper development of each child.

Kiviõli has several opportunities. Volunteer may also take on activities in a local school, with a focus on improving school environment and studies.

Service will last from early 2025 until June 2026. Dates and duration are flexible.

If you are curious, visit our Instagram: instagram.com/noorngo or contact richard@erinoor.ee

Volunteers will live alone in a flat nearby town.

Volunteers will receive work related trainings if it is necessary. All special techniques used with the target group will also be taught to the volunteers if they are interested in learning. Erasmus+ and ESC Agency in Estonia will organize on-arrival and mid-term trainings for volunteers.

Volunteer should be independent and ready to live in a small community. Should have good communication skills and strong sense of responsibility. Volunteers should be interested in local culture, educational system and hold humanistic values.

Solidarity Tracks wishes to host for long term (358 days)  volunteers in order to manage the Time bank Lefkada and the Smart city platform, to promote exchange of free services among the local community, particularly in art & culture. Volunteer's Tasks: - To manage the Lefkada Time Bank website and Facebook page. - To organize and implement events that meet the needs of network members in term of art and culture. - To follow the exchanges of services between members and create group exchanges. - To create tools and promotional events for Lefkada Time Bank. - To exchange services with members of the network on spot and remotely. - To contribute for the creation, implementation and maintenance of the "Smart Lefkada" platform, while cooperating with a diverse local network. - To digitize and disseminate cultural events that take place in the region to give access to all citizens, especially the ones with less opportunities.

Accommodation: the volunteers will be hosted at Volunteers home in Lefkas which is in the centre of the town, very close to
the office, bars, restaurants, shops and the seaside as well. The house has 3 rooms (each room is shared by 2 volunteers).

In case the house is not available, volunteers will be hosted in a shared flat/studio for 2-4 persons.

On-site trainings organized by the hosting organization.
Online trainings through the following:
https://learn2volunteer.com/ 
https://youtheclub.eu/index.php/about/
https://www.esc2learn.org/#
https://sportsocialact.com/

Motivated and creative youngsters who enjoy working with young people and who would like to spend one year by learning and helping others. Preferably with some digital/ artistic skills.

Klub Sportowy Beniaminek 03, and explore potential collaboration opportunities. We are a Sports Club, NGO, Regional Information Point for FRSE in the Pomeranian region, Youth Center, Social Cooperative, and Regional Center for NGOs and Volunteering for Pomeranian NGOs.
We operate in five sports sectors:
Football
Kickboxing
Horse Riding
Table Tennis
Additionally, we focus on inclusive sports for seniors and people with disabilities. We also organize cultural activities with our volunteers and actively engage in kindergartens.
As an accredited Erasmus+ organization, we are highly committed to implementing projects under Erasmus+ and the European Solidarity Corps (ESC). Our team consists of seven experienced youth workers, and with our well-equipped infrastructure (sports fields, halls, farm, kickboxing facilities, schools), we host approximately 100 volunteers annually in various projects.

The project will be short term individual 50+2 days travel. 
We are seeking volunteers who are patient, tolerant, and adapt at working with children and with local.
We are searching volunteers who has sports background are needed to assist our coaches in football trainings and
horse riding activities who can help us with dealing horses (cleaning,training them) in the farm.

Contributing to the skills of families and young people to tackle social problems and economic deprivation. To ensure that young people acquire self-defence skills by learning the methods developed to protect them from social risks and to help them actively participate in social life.

Volunteers are offered their rights under the rules of the European Solidarity Programme. We pay particular attention to accommodation, catering, and activities designed to bring people's creativity to the forefront.  In addition to the city transfer fees, there is unlimited internet and television in the living quarters. Payments are made by hand and adapted to the conditions of the day. Volunteers' cleaning and household cleaning materials are provided by our association. Especially living areas are selected from the regions where families live.

Optional activities are offered where participants can improve themselves in their social lives. We try to increase their sense of responsibility by emphasising activities that they can develop themselves. In particular, trainings are provided in order to provide them with extensive knowledge about the cultural structure of Turkey, opportunities are offered for them to participate in special days and to visit important centres.

Our association deals with disadvantaged and underprivileged children, youth and their family members. Our social service-oriented project focuses on activities that increase socialization and social adaptation processes. We need volunteers who love working with people, who will be happy to be with young people in particular, who are patient, creative and who like to take responsibility. Would you like to be with us?

Info Jeunes Grand Est is a youth information centre that informs young people about a variety of topics such as their studies, accommodation, and jobs. For 20 years, it has also served as the host organization for the EUROPE DIRECT Centre, helping bring the European Union closer to citizens and encouraging their participation in discussions about the EU's future. During their European Solidarity Corps (ESC) experience, the volunteer will participate in the activities of EUROPE DIRECT Reims: 
- Take part in the "European Ambassadors Campaign" to share their culture and experiences, raising awareness among secondary school students about European diversity.
- Participate in and help organize events to promote the EU and European citizenship activities (Escape Games, "Europe for Beginners", etc...), events focused on International mobility, etc... 
- Help with the communication (creating visuals and videos, manage social media content, write articles and newsletter for the website...)

The volunteer will live in a shared apartment fully furnished and will have his/her own bedroom. The bathroom, kitchen and living room will be shared. The volunteer will receive money for food, local transport and pocket money.

The volunteer should have an interest in the European Union and its values. He/she should enjoy interacting with pupils and be keen on using communication tools such as social media, videos, and photos. Ability to work in a team is essential. A basic level of French (B1/B2) would be appreciated and will help the volunteer integrate more easily. In order to apply, please fill in the form on this link: https://eu.jotform.com/form/200683179963364

Wärmestube and FRIDA - Day Centre for homeless people and special area for homeless women - offers 1 placement for European volunteers. As we want to learn from young people, the volunteers will be part of the team. The volunteers with their ideas, abilities and creativity will support the social workers in their daily activities by preparing and giving food to our clients, helping cleaning up at the end of the day, as well as helping our clients with laundry and care of health. Furthermore, our clients will benefit from talking, playing, organizing additional offers like free time activities and by helping them with their appointments. 
The volunteer will get an insight into our social system, into our organization, into poverty and what it means and how policy in Austria handle it. Cultural exchange will bring benefits for everyone - the clients, the volunteers and the hosting department.

Volunteer will have free lodging, food and pocket money; more info in the infodescription on request by mailing to susanne.rosmann@4yougend.at!

Volunteer will have all trainings regarding the ESC rules. On Arrival & Mid term meeting

United in Action is a volunteer project coordinated by the Foundation of Entrepreneurial Society Development (FRSP) in Poland and the United Societies of Balkans (USB) in Greece.

The aim of the project is to promote social activity, intercultural solidarity, and civic engagement among young people through volunteering initiatives in various European countries. The program places strong emphasis on organizing external activities for the local community, such as workshops, cultural events, and awareness campaigns.

More information you can find here! https://volo.frsp.eu/2025/10/30/wolontariat-dlugoterminowy-w-grecji/

What do we provide?

Henner health insurance during your project
Travel reimbursement up to €309 round trip (depends on the distance between participant’s hometown and the project venue) 
Pocket money: EUR 7 per day
Food money/catering service
Accommodation
Working hours: 30-35 working hours per week
Days off: there are two days off for each month

More information you can find here! https://volo.frsp.eu/2025/10/30/wolontariat-dlugoterminowy-w-grecji/

Volunteers’ Profile:

The selection of the participants is mostly based on their motivation and personal interest in the topics of the project. Our ideal volunteer candidate is an open minded person willing to learn, to improve her/himself and to help other people. It is important to be ready to work in a team and to share daily life with people from different backgrounds. It is not necessary to have a previous technical knowledge of media. Although it is not required to have a high level of English, the volunteers need to have at least a basic knowledge of the language for their everyday communication with international and local people but also for their safety.

1. Promote International Engagement :
Support group mobility projects focused on inclusion and equal opportunities.
Co-lead eTwinning projects.
Act as a European ambassador.
Organize language café sessions.
2. Enhance Local and School Visibility:
Collaborate with local partners
Lead school and extracurricular activities for exchanges with children.
Promote projects both internally and externally (Erasmus Days, Language Week, Europe Day).
Create an online journal or comic strip to highlight activities and raise awareness on Sustainable Development Goals, citizenship, digitalization, and inclusion.

The volunteer will have accommodation within the school premises. The apartment reserved for hosting external individuals is a type F4 (3 bedrooms + 1 living room + 1 equipped kitchen + 1 bathroom) provided free of charge. The volunteer will have a single room and will share common areas with the two language assistants. Lunch meals can be taken at the school's half board system for a fee of €1.91 per meal. This option is available from Monday to Friday outside of school periods.  As the school is located in the city center, the volunteer has access to all amenities and nearby shops.



Engagement with young people requires experience. However, we welcome adolescent students aged 15 to 20 years old, so the volunteer must demonstrate maturity and perspective regarding this age group.
They should possess strong oral communication skills and be comfortable interacting with teenagers.
Additionally, a good command of information and communication technologies (website management, social media) is essential.

We are Christian Catholic NGO called VIAC – Institute for youth support and development. Nowadays we are looking for long-term (1 year or 6 months) volunteers, preferably those who have positive attitude to Christianity and are willing to share those values among young people. Also, we are looking for someone who has skills to create posters, videos etc. All the description of the place and positions you can find on this website: https://volunteering.ozviac.sk. Please, check the website before applying. Please, do not write motivational statement using AI. Volunteering starting dates can be discussed with us.

Travel costs will be reimbursed up to the distance band, in according to the rules of Erasmus+. Volunteers will be accommodated either in the flat in centre of Trstená or Tvrdošín. Volunteers will receive pocket money as well as money for food. They can have lunch in our organisation or arrange their own food.

Volunteers will have onboarding training in our organisation. On-arrival and mid-term training will be provided by our National Agency.

The children are divided into 5 independent households with 10 places, 4 welcoming children from 3 to 14 years old and 1 teenage household for over 15s.
In the project of the establishment, the professionals have to accompany the child in the daily life :
▪ getting up, washing, eating, going to bed, etc
▪ take them to school 
▪ help for the homework 
▪ organize activities (games, going outside...)

The placement wants to host 2 european volunteers, from september 2025 until summer 2026.

The volunteers will live in a flat in the placement, in a space dedicated to them
The food will be cover by the placement.

The volunteers will participate to 3 seminars with the coordinating organization VISA-AD (welcome, mid-term, end), and 2 seminars with the National Agency.

As a host entity, we offer the "Shared Lives" project in which the volunteer can imagine, prepare and lead activities for users of the Sant Lluís Geriatric Center. These activities may include: crafts, memory activities, adapted physical activities, etc.
We offer the possibility for young Europeans to learn through interactions with the elderly by participating in a service where you can care and accompany the residents through their daily routine.  In exchange, the residents will benefit from the ideas, youth, energy and international experience of the volunteers. 

You will become part of the local community through the interaction with the residents, their family members, as well as with the center's workers. Democratic values ​​are promoted, such as: solidarity and social cohesion.

This particular project is attached to a certain ammount of working hours per week (35 max).

The flat is fully paid by the organisation and you will have an allowance set by country, with money for living expenses, shopping and pocket money for you. You will also get a transport card to be able to travel by bus to other towns around the island.

Volunteers should understand that they will be living with volunteers from other countries with other customs and culture.

You will be explained what sort of activities we carry out during the year, and will get the opportunity to bring your ideas and implement them with the support of the team.

You will take Spanish lessons weekly.

You will also participate in the on-arrival training for a week during the first month of your volunteering activity. It's a great opportunity to share experiences and get more of a European dimension through contact with other volunteers. Then, half-way through your volunteering there's the mid-term training for another week of networking.

We are looking for two volunteers for this project to complement each other and work as a duo.
We are looking for 
- someone who enjoys being with elderly peolpe, with empathy and patience, who enjoys organizing activities.
- good listening skills.
- Spanish knowledge is a plus, as the residents will mainly comunicate in this language.
- team players, as you will collaborate with another volunteer and the rest of the team in Sant Lluís' geriatric residence.

The volunteers will be involved in the following activities:
- support the daily life of the association, helping the staff with after school activities of kids from 6 to 14 years or, leisure time activities for kids from 3 to 6 years, and general management of the space, break time, entrance and exit of the kids;
- activities related with literature, sports, music or theater for children, sometimes open to parents and the local community; Volunteers will be involved from the preparation to the phase of implementation;

Solidarités Jeunesses (SJ) is a national movement of non-formal education and is composed of a National Secretary (Paris), and eight regional delegations across France. Our delegations host international volunteers throughout the year. Each regional delegation is unique, but all of the activities organized benefit the local community and share common ground: - gather people from different culture and social background to participate in social, ecological and cultural development. - contribute to the integration of people with fewer opportunities. Each project is dedicated to actions of solidarity and collective living. We believe that cultural exchanges are a key for personal learning and for the volunteer to experiment and undergo personal development.

The place of the association is in the middle of the forest, having a strong link with nature. INFO AND APPLICATION PROCESS : https://www.solidaritesjeunesses.org/volunteeringinfrance

You will work about 35 hours per week, tasks include: Organization of collective life (cooking, cleaning, logistics), ecological construction in wood, hosting groups of youth with lesser opportunities, Participating in animation of international workcamps during the summer, Organization and participation in cultural events for different publics

You will be together with 4 other international volunteers, and 5 youth with lesser opportunities and accompanied by the staff.

There is no competencies required to participate but willingness to the volunteering project and being open to discover new cultures. Open to everybody from European Union or partner countries between 18/30 years old, the driving licence is HIGHLY recommended but what matters the most is the motivation ! So if you like MANUAL WORK, NATURE and COLLECTIVE LIFE, or if you're interested to discover it, contact us! Dates can be flexible!

on-arrival training
mid-term training
dutch lessons

What are we looking for: a pro-active networker. Who is able to get the right  information and turn this into practise with a team of professionals. Volunteer will spend 4 days per week in Gymnasium and economics highschool Trbovlje under supervision and guidance of a teacher. 
Their tasks will be:
-Speak/train the German language with the students.
-Prepare interesting non-formal activities in German language for the students
-Present the culture in the school.
-Implement one Solidarity activity in the school. 
The volunteer will help at the youth center and with after-school activities/events for youth (at least 1 to 2 times a week).

Allowance: EUR 5/day  
Food allowance: EUR 126 Reimbursement of food costs: up to EUR 70 (paid upon receipt) 
Free travel card for public transport in Trbovlje (optional) 
Apartments in the ZMŠT hostel – bed, corner with a workbench, a shared kitchen, and a bathroom with a toilet. The kitchen and bathroom are shared with a volunteer from the neighboring apartment.

On arrival and mid-term training organized by the National Agency.

We are looking for a German-speaking volunteer to help in high school under the supervision and guidance of a teacher. Motivated to work with students, kind, helpful, reliable, creative, is willing to learn something new and share his knowledge with others.

Svitac is a multi-ethnic youth arts organisation in based in Brčko, in the northeast of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Since 1998 they have worked in Brčko applying creative arts and education activities to encourage reconciliation within the community following the devastating mid-1990s Bosnian war that the land has yet to really recover from. They know from experience that working on shared interests can help strengthen a community as a whole, and overcome perceived boundaries between peoples or with their environment. They organise a wide variety of workshops throughout the year, focusing on arts and education and also organise summer camps for the children of Brčko every year. The volunteers work in the children and youth center in all areas.

Svitac’s volunteers live in a shared apartment or house, which is rented by Svitac. There is a house where three volunteers can stay, and a flat where two can be. Both locations have internet access and volunteers are also more than welcome to use the internet connection in Svitac’s office or at the youth center. Each volunteer has their own bedroom and a shared kitchen, living room and bathroom. Two-week volunteers may sometimes sleep on a sofa-bed in the living room or in the available spare room. Sheets and towels are provided, unless volunteers want to bring their own.

Departure Training in Germany 
- On Arrival Training and MidTerm Evaluation provided by the National Agency 
- introduction and orientation training at arrival 
- basic nonformal learning, group dynamics and basic youthwork 
- language support 
- mentor support 
- coordinator support

Svitac is particularly keen to engage with volunteers that have art, music and language skills, as these are our core focus areas. We do not require volunteers to be professionals or to hold formal qualifications, but we are interested in volunteers with general skills and who are capable of adapting to the challenges of working with different age groups and an unfamiliar working environment.

We welcome you to join our volunteer program who wants to carry out sports activities and education with children.
In order to participate in this program, you must make an agreement with a leading organization from your country and the sending organization.
1) Recreational activities with children: These activities throughout the whole season will be linked to the activities of the four seasons center, in which a large number of children participate from May to December. 2) sports training project activities: In this context, in addition to supporting the specific activities of the team and the organization of matches and championships, they will also be able to support their participation in events for different sports. 4) Communication: In this specific activity sector, volunteers will be able to contribute according to their specific skills by producing short videos presenting the various activities of the sports club, short radio podcasts containing the story.

You can join our volunteer service with a leading organization that will cover your travel, accommodation and pocket money financial expenses.

Turkish Language traininig

physical Education Training programme with kids

The ESC project concerns two areas: disability and the promotion of volunteering among young people. 
The project takes place in the following organizations: La Finestra daily center and CSV Insubria (Volunteer center).
The European volunteer supports the team of La Finestra Centre for about 25 hours a week and the team of CSV for about 10 hours per month.

The project proposes innovative activities that use various methods to achieve the goal of social inclusion with particular attention to European awareness. We intend to implement a project in which young people can freely express their ability in terms of solidarity and spirit of initiative
At the CSV the volunteer will be mainly involved in actions related to young people (promotion of volunteering in schools, planning of youth events ...), and the contribution will be peer-to-peer.

Volunteers are hosted in Casa Grizzetti: a fully equipped house, with two bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen and a bathroom. The house has also a garden. Volunteers will be given informal learning process support through active participation in monthly group training on the YOUTH PASS certificate.

All people aged 18 - 30, who have a genuine interest and passion for working with young people, social and cultural issues and are interested in culture, communication and social media. Participants can be involved in various tasks our organization carries out: from managing social media to logistic assistance in different projects and festivals. 
The aim of the project is to revitalize the region through different events and activities, so we are looking for someone who will bring new ideas and the energy to bring them to life. 
IN ORDER TO APPLY PLEASE VISIT https://www.parcoculturalealtalanga.it/vitality-2025

While this is a volunteering opportunity, we are looking for dedicated and hard-working individuals — THIS IS NOT A VACATION. Here, you are the maker of your own experience — we provide the space, the resources, and the opportunity to grow, but it is your engagement and curiosity that will make it truly meaningful.

As a volunteer for Kulturzentrum Schlachthof e.V., you would join one of the biggest and diverse cultural centres of Bremen. You would become a part of their big, self-governed team that is divided into smaller subteams, for example the team that works with children in a theatre group, the media team that provides courses for young people in videography, and the music team that organises bandcamps of upcoming amateur musicians of Bremen. The cultural centre also organises a wide range of events – from climate change festivals to concerts, lectures and exhibitions, where your support would be needed particularly for the visibility – taking pictures, videos and managing the Instagram Channel of the organisation.

You will be accommodated in your own room a flat in Bremen with 4 other ESC volunteers. Bremen is a city in North-West Germany (around 500.000 inhabitants), not far from the North Sea coast. It is a vibrant, multi-cultural city with a lot of young people and both a historical center and newer areas of towns. As an ESC volunteer, you will receive health insurance, 210€ monthly pocket money, 312€ for living expenses. Travel costs will be reimbursed depending on the travel distance (normally between 211€-395€).

n the beginning of your stay with us in Bremen, you will have a weekly meeting with your mentor to learn how everything works and you will develop your skills on the way! If you are someone who thrives in social events, enjoys cultural exchange, and is comfortable striking up conversations with kids and teenagers, then you might be just who we're looking for! We are Community, a French non-profit organization located in Arques (Hauts-de-France, near Saint-Omer). Our goal is to strengthen social bonds within our local community by empowering people of all ages and backgrounds through creative, inclusive, and educational projects. We promote values such as human dignity, respect, solidarity, and intercultural dialogue. At Community, we’re looking for a dynamic and friendly volunteer who enjoys being part of social events, connecting with children and teenagers, and discovering diverse cultures.

- Open-minded and sociable, able to connect with people from different backgrounds and cultures
- Creative, autonomous, and comfortable interacting with children and teenagers
- Interested in gaining international experience and discovering new ways of life (past travel or international experience is a plus!)
- Willing to learn or improve their French, which will be the main language used in the project
- Values of solidarity and respect
- Ability to speak about intercultural topics and to adapt the wording according to the audience

- Take part in local events organized by the association and contribute to their planning and execution (festivals, cultural days, community gatherings...).
- Help create engaging content for social media, sharing your experience and promoting our activities.

Volunteers can participate in all activities at the position of teacher's assistant, they can prepare their own activities based on their field of interest. They are a proper member of the Jasan team and we try to involve them in all events and activities as much as we can.

(teachers) and one assistant in the class. In the afternoon children can participate in the afternoon club. More info you find: https://www.skolajasan.cz/.

accommodation, food, transport and pocket money are covered

expeditions around Nedvedice, Tisnov and over South Moravia and Vysocina mountains. The
volunteers will improve teaching skills (formal and non-formal), language and social skills.

trainings too. If they are interested, they can visit trainings, shorttime courses, seminars
offered to other employees of the school staff or visit other alternative schools and
kindergartens associated with Hnízdo.

flexibility, playfulness and sense of humour are appreciated as well as a certain level of English.

learning and behavioural disorders and courage to realize their own project. We do not require
any specific education.

Its main goal is to match international volunteering with the empowerment of the local community in which the volunteers will live in.

The local community also benefits from the meeting and cooperation with young European volunteers.

The volunteers will take part in the activities, mostly the ones with children and youngsters

The volunteers will share a flat located in Frattattamaggiore, in a walking distance to the activities venues, as well as train station, main shops and entertainment opportunities. The flat is fully furnished, with fast wi-fi connection, two bedrooms, kitchen, bathroom, common room and a small balcony, and equipped. The volunteers will receive a monthly allowance for their meals, beside a pocket money for their personal expenses. 
The volunteers will also receive a bicycle to ease their movements across the town and to the venues where the activities take place.

"Voice of Youth" is a volunteering project of 61–90 days where Dutch volunteers join forces with Moroccan youth in Larache to deliver workshops that empower the local community. These include digital skills, cultural exchange, and creative activities like mural painting or theater and more. The project aims to give a voice to youth by providing them with practical tools, self-confidence, and the chance to express themselves. It also promotes intercultural learning and collaboration between Dutch and Moroccan participants. Through non-formal education and teamwork, Voice of Youth helps build connections, inspire change, and create a positive social impact in Larache.

By hosting the Voice of Youth project, Larache offers a meaningful space for international volunteers to work directly with local children and youth, support their personal development, and encourage new ways of learning.

You will be housed in an appartement in the same building as the activity space, but on a separate floor keeping your accommodation private and well separated from your workplace. The kitchen, bathroom and living room are shared with other volunteers. Depending on the amount of volunteers present at the moment you may have to share your bedroom with a volunteer of the same gender. You will find all facilities you need within walking distance. 
You'll receive a monthly budget for food to do groceries and cook with your flatmates or by yourself.

Language classes in Darija (Moroccan Arabic) will be provided, which you can practice further during the workshops with the youth and in your everyday life going to the market, bakery, etc. People are very hospitable and easy to approach. The working language of the project is English and you will always be supported by a local volunteer to translate where needed.

Your mentor will support your development in pedagogy, organisation skills and offer coaching based on your learning goals.

Curious, ready to collaborate, with knowledge of digital skills, creativity, environmentalism, mental health or another topic that you would like to spread awareness on!

The Steinbeis Innovation Centre "European Projects" (OID: E10206422) is accredited as a coordinating organisation within the ESC-program, for hosting volunteers we are cooperating with several organisations of the german social and health care system. We have still some vacancies in projects for children, as well as elderly and/or disabled people starting in February 2022 or later. The projects are located in the Black Forest region in southwestern Germany, close to the borders to France and Switzerland. With these projects, the coordinating organisation wants to the employability of young people and promotes mobility as a strategy against unemployment. Volunteers who are interested in training or further education in Germany after their voluntary service, or who are looking for a job receive the necessary advice on bureaucratic requirements (Recognition of certificates, etc.), application procedures, etc.

Accommodation: Volunteers get a separated single room in a flat near the hosting organisation. Bathroom and kitchen are to share with other volunteers. 
Food: Volunteers get an amount of 210 € per month for food from the hosting organisation, on workdays volunteers can also take prepared meals in  the host organisation.
Local transport: As an additional benefit the volunteers get the so called Deutschlandticket which is valid for all means of public transport in Germany (except high speed trains like EC/IC/ICE)

Volunteers are obliged to participate in the official training cycle offered by the National Agency. Apart from that the coordination organisation organises an internal introductory seminar where they meet other volunteers from projects in the region.
Volunteers can participate in internal job development activities at the institution.
The coordinating organisation provides a continuous language training for volunteers; the main purpose of which is to understand everyday talk. They will also learn technical vocabulary for their volunteer duties in this institution.

In terms of volunteers, the main target group of our projects are young people with fewer educational opportunities, i.e. without an academic degree or even a university entrance qualification.
Volunteers should want to work with children, elderly and/or disabled people. They should be open to working with people in need of care  and people who are excluded from society. Past experience in working with such people would be helpful.
Candidates interested in joining one of our projects should send us their CV and complete a questionnaire they can get from us upon request.

As we kick off 2026, we’re bringing a vibrant mix of exciting project and activities! Volunteers will join forces with children during the winter break, leading creative workshops, sports, DIY sessions, and cultural exchanges. Our outreach in schools will highlight important themes like homelessness, equal opportunities, cultural diversity, and human rights through dynamic programs such as Eurocamps and CATventures. Volunteers will also host wellbeing sessions — from healthy cooking to mental health awareness — linked with global observances like Zero Waste Day and International Language Day. We’ll celebrate International Women’s Day with empowering events that honor women’s achievements, and promote linguistic diversity through fun language-focused activities. To wrap up, we’ll host the WASP Charity Event — a lively festival of music, games, and fundraising for a great cause!

1. Pocket money as per ESC Guide (2024) 2. Food allowance and house cleaning supplies 3. will get Henner health cover 4. Fully furnished houses, 2 to 10 minutes away from the Office, shared accommodation with other volunteers, common space , bathroom …etc 5. has access to foundation bikes 6. Reimbursement or coverage for local transport when used for work 7. Reimbursement for travel tickets according to ESC Guide.

During the initiation of the project, there will be an Adaptation Week, Cultural events. This period will provide an opportunity to collaborate with an international team, with English as the working language, and an introduction to the Polish language. Mentoring session weekly to tackle topics that serve personal growth. Participants will develop the ability to engage in conversations in multiple languages. Upon the completion of the mobility program, participants will receive a Youth Pass / ESC Volunteer Diploma.

A genuine passion for working kids and helping them succeed An extroverted personality with good communication Demonstrate experience in designing and delivering training activities Ability to manage a group workshop The ability to adapt teaching methods to different learning styles A positive attitude towards feedback and continuous improvement A team player who can collaborate effectively with others Good organizational and time management skills.

full_description:
Volunteers will join Klaster Innowacji Społecznych in Gliwice, Poland – a modern, well-equipped organisation with its own educational centre in the Beskid Mountains. The project focuses on three main areas: inclusion of young refugees and disadvantaged youth through cultural and language integration; digital education including workshops on AI tools, cyber safety, and media literacy; and ecological actions such as zero-waste campaigns, clean-ups, and green education. Volunteers will support the design and delivery of workshops, organize youth events, assist in social outreach, and co-create content. Each volunteer will choose their main area of involvement and will be trained and supported throughout. Together, we create a community of solidarity, growth, and meaningful local impact.

Volunteers are accommodated in fully equipped apartments in Gliwice or Katowice. They work in a modern, high-standard office in the city centre with access to training rooms, vehicles, and professional equipment. Each volunteer receives pocket money (~180 EUR/month), food allowance or meals, and a Multisport card. All local transport for project activities is covered.

Volunteers receive onboarding, on-arrival and mid-term trainings, task-specific coaching, and weekly mentoring. Language support (Polish) and Youthpass guidance are provided. Trainings and team-building take place at our modern educational centre in Międzybrodzie Bialskie, located by the lake in the Beskid Mountains. This space offers ideal conditions for learning, integration, and reflection.

We are looking for motivated young people aged 18–30, eager to contribute to community-based actions in Poland. Ideal candidates are open-minded, proactive, and curious about social change. No formal qualifications are required – just the will to learn and collaborate. Volunteers can choose between three paths: 1) supporting young refugees through integration and cultural events; 2) engaging youth in digital education (AI, media literacy, cybersecurity); or 3) promoting ecology and climate awareness through creative and hands-on actions. Empathy, teamwork, and a sense of responsibility are highly valued.

Alianza por la Solidaridad, a member of ActionAid, aims to achieve an active citizenship that fights against inequalities and for the recognition of human rights. It carries out development cooperation and education projects to eradicate gender-based violence, migrants' rights and for climate justice. Join us at our office in Bogota! The volunteer will support advocacy spaces and participate in cooperation and humanitarian aid projects, implementing communication strategies for both external and internal audiences. Additionally, they will carry out activities that help position the organization and its advocacy efforts in the media and on social networks. The volunteer will also support the development of projects that contribute to the sustainability of the organization and its advocacy initiatives.

You will have the opportunity to live in a family home with a private room, access to shared services, Wi-Fi, a mobile communication card, and the residence is close to the office with convenient access to local transportation. You will receive a monthly allowance of 607,98€ for your personal expenses, including food and local transport. You will also be able to interact with the communities where we carry out our projects

You will receive training which will cover topics such as: induction to Alianza por la Solidaridad, induction to the European Solidarity Corps, responsibilities and rights of the organisations and of the volunteer, Youthpass, Henner insurance and SHEA. In addition, you will learn about communication within a social organization in the field and receive specific training on feminist leadership, communication for transformation, among other topics.

We are looking for a person eager to learn and work in a team and able to adapt to the context. Basic knowledge of communication and project management. Familiarity with Web 2.0 applications and new technologies (social media, websites, blogs) as well as online tools for creating graphic materials. A minimum of elementary-level Spanish is required.

full_description:
Hälsa International Togo is a non-profit social and humanitarian organisation working to promote and protect the rights of vulnerable children and girls in Togo. The organisation's main aim is to combat social inequalities among children and young girls in vulnerable situations and to promote their social and family reintegration. It aspires to a world where children and young girls can grow and flourish in an environment conducive to their development and become the actors and agents of change, they wish to see in their lives.

The support of the volunteers will allow the local team to be strengthened with quality human resources to implement in-depth research on street- connected children and young girls in street situations in Togo. The results of these actions will not only allow the government of Togo to design a social strategy adapted to this target group but also allow Hälsa International Togo to propose long-term programs and services based on qualitative evidence.

Volunteers will be living in a guest house. Volunteers will have their own room with access to electricity, clean water and internet. Internet bills will be paid by the volunteers.
The organization will provide all the groceries and volunteers will oversee cooking their own food.  
A local staff and the organization’s driver will be welcoming volunteers from the airport to the place they will be hosted and same for their departure. Most of our volunteer’s house or host families are less than 30 min from the airport.

During their stay, we will build the volunteers' capacity on local culture, working methods and basic local language courses. They will also be introduced to the local authorities and the local EU representation in Togo. Quarterly evaluation workshops of their stay will take place. Finally, the project manager will be available to accompany the volunteers on possible culture shocks and community integration.

Male and female are both welcomed. We appreciate between 25-35 years old volunteers with university degree.

full_description:
Une Terre Culturelle propose une mission de volontariat dans différents centres sociaux de Marseille.

Les centres sociaux sont implantés dans différents quartiers de Marseille, très riches et mixtes culturellement. Il s’agit d’accompagner les publics - enfants, jeunes et/ou familles - dans leur relation à l’école. La présence de volontaires apporte beaucoup à la scolarité des enfants et permet de dépasser les inégalités dans le rapport à l’école.

Les missions confiées sont différentes et variées en fonction des centres sociaux comme :
- Donner une méthodologie aux enfants : apprendre à s’organiser soi-même, accompagner à l'autonomie
- Soutenir l'aide aux devoirs
- Participer à l’animation socio-culturelle et sportive des enfants, ados, accueillis dans le centre social en fonction des compétences, projets, envies du/de la volontaire, des projets avec tout public pourront être réalisés.
- Soutenir la mise en place d'échanges interculturels.

À discuter lors de l'entretien

2 ESC seminars are taken in charge during the volunteering.

Nous recherchons des jeunes volontaires motivé·e·s, qui souhaitent s'engager auprès de la société civile, au sein d'un centre social. Le·la volontaire sera à l'aise avec les enfants et les jeunes. Nous recherchons des jeunes qui ont une connaissance de base du français et souhaite améliorer leur apprentissage de la langue.

Il·elle devra être motivé·e et faire preuve d'engagement et intiative.

The Padre Tobias Foundation is an institution that aims to promote social responses to the community where it is inserted, in particular with child, youth and elderly people intervening in an integrated and personalized way. The added value of integrating this project is that we can work with young people in our community, as well as with young people from foreign countries, thus providing them with the possibility of acquiring new technical and psychosocial skills through intercultural sharing. The activities for volunteers are related to the support that the Foundation promotes in the community where it is inserted, namely with the elderly, nursery and kindergarten, and the Second Chance School.

The Padre Tobias Foundation has a house solely for the volunteers and it's named "International House". This house is located in a strategic place in the city center, in order to provide quick access to the essential services to the daily life. The house itself is functional, cozy and simple, but it's not fit for people with reduced mobility. The volunteers will have at their disposa food provided by the Padre Tobias Foundation, so that they can cook their own meals.

As per the protocol of the European Solidarity Corps, volunteers have training upon arrival at the National Agency. During their activities, volunteers will be offered Portuguese language classes for non-native speakers.

The Padre Tobias Foundation wants volunteers to be involved and integrated in the dynamics of the institution. The Foundation has preference for volunteers with experience in volunteer work, preferably in the area of children and elderly. There are no requirements regarding the level of education or training on the part of the volunteer, being only necessary the interest in the work developed in the proposed activities. Among the personal qualities we would like to to receive dynamic young people, with responsibilities, tolerance, conscience and willingness to help.

AWO Stuttgart operates several Begegnungszentren (community meeting centres), which serve as meeting points for social interaction, cultural activities, and everyday support. Our facilities offer a wide range of programs, helping seniors lead independent and active lives.
We look forward to welcoming you as a volunteer in our Begegnungszentrum Zuffenhausen if you are interested in helping us with the following tasks:
•	You will assist in planning, organizing, and carrying out recreational, educational, and cultural activities for the visitors (ex. game nights, craft sessions, lectures...)
•	You will support our visitors by providing transportation services
•	You will assist our visitors with everyday tasks such as filling out forms, accompanying them...
•	You will run errands for the facility or our visitors, whether it’s for daily needs or special events.
•	You will work with the team and take on general organizational tasks (event preparation, administartion...)

You will live in either a shared apartment or a residential home with other young adults who are new to Germany. This accommodation is in close proximity to tram, bus, and S-Bahn stations, making downtown Stuttgart accessible within minutes. Additionally, we provide a "Deutschlandticket" for public transportation in all of Germany.
You will receive monthly pocket money and food allowance according to ESC guidlines.

During your volunteering you will attend two trainings organized by the German National Agency (on-arrival and mid-term training). You will become part of an experienced team and a  supervisor will be available to answer your questions at any time. You will have the opportunity to meet other volunteers. 
Your hosting organisation will also provide additional German classes depending on your level.

You are our perfect volunteer if you enjoy working with people, bringing different generations together, supporting them in their daily lives; have a driver’s license and have a basic understanding of German (A1 required).
If this sounds interesting to you, please apply on the portal and we will get in touch with you shortly! :)

ADRA Serbia is a humanitarian organization dedicated to reducing poverty and protecting vulnerable people. By partnering with communities and organizations, we can improve the quality of life of Roma people, the homeless, and young people leaving care through our programs in education, economic empowerment, and protection. Psycho-social support, prevention, and protection from gender-based violence are mainstreamed in the projects. We need you to assist our logistician in her daily tasks such as tracking the movement of the goods, preparing documents for procurement procedures, preparing and distribution of the humanitarian assistance where you will have the opportunity to be in the field with the field staff and assist directly to the people and children in need. You will also have a chance to take part in improving the logistics system. Communicating with socially responsible businesses for support could also be among your tasks.

We will provide you with appropriate accommodation. You might share the accommodation with another volunteer in a situation when deployments overlap. You will have your own lockable room. The accommodation will be near our Community Center, near your workspace. The Community Center is 13 km (about 8.08 mi) away from the city center. The public lines to the city center are very frequent (every 5-15 minutes, depending on the public transport line). You will be provided with a monthly allowance of 450 EUR to cover the expenses for food and transport.

ADRA Serbia will ensure initial, orientation training and ongoing training always encouraging self-assessment and adjustment of arrangements so to effect maximum positive impact. Your learning and development are important to us! So, you will have the opportunity and be encouraged to attend various training workshops online, in various modalities. ADRA Serbia can offer you trainings related to the direct work with vulnerable people. We will be glad to hear from you about your interests and try to organize the training or to look for available trainings for you.

We are looking for a dedicated volunteer with a passion for helping others. Since the beneficiaries are vulnerable people, it is important to have well-developed social skills, compassion, and some skills in crowd management that will be necessary at distribution sites. Apply if you have ---BA in business management or a relevant field---Strong organizational and communication skills, problem solving skills, and practical approach --- Digital skills --- Inclination to analyze data to improve operations and make necessary changes. We promote inclusivity and encourage candidates from diverse backgrounds and abilities to apply, so do not hesitate to sign up for this opportunity.

DISCOVER-U project offers a 9-month volunteer placement in Hyvärilä youth centre on the shore of beautiful lake Pielinen. Two volunteers will participate in camp-school related activities and learn basic Finnish youth centre pedagogy and Finnish cultural background. Volunteers will help running events and projects, which gather many international participants annually. Tasks for volunteers include assisting youth workers in running camp school activities with youth 13-17 years old, arranging workshops in local youth house, social media posts, occasionally helping out in the kitchen/maintenance, personal creative project. Love for nature, working with young people, and spending time in secluded locations are essential!

Accommodation in Hyvärilä youth centre, in a wooden house for volunteers and seasonal workers in a single room with shared shower, kitchen, and living room. Meals are served in cafeteria. Travel costs (up to the maximum lump sums according to ESC program limits), accommodation and meals are covered by the hosting organization. Volunteers get pocket money, and a bicycle to go to Nurmes (3.5 km away). Pocket money 7 EUR/day. Volunteers earn 2 holiday days per month according to the Finnish work law.

The program includes pre-departure training by a supporting organization, an on-arrival (in Kokkola) and a midterm training during the volunteer project.

The project is looking for two motivated young individuals, who are eager to develop their artistic and creative skills, engage in team activities with young people from other countries, learn about different cultures and share their own culture with others. Interest in culture, history, arts and creativity, media, digital resources and languages will be a benefit. See more about volunteer work in Hyvärilä on Instagram @volunteers_eastfinland and hyvarilavolunteers.home.blog.
Learn more about us on Instagram @hyvarilainternational and google us before applying. We are located in a remote rural area, a 7-hour train ride away from Helsinki. 

P.S. we love AI just as much as everyone else, but please do not rely on it for your motivation letter. Let the real YOU shine ;)

Our daily center Lumea Lui Pinocchio has the main mission to support disadvantaged children by offering them a safe space. Every day, the children benefit from non-formal educational activities, help with their homework, as well as a warm lunch and snack.
Most of the children come from the Roma community, where families often face high levels of illiteracy and unemployment. 
The activity is about engaging the children in art forms such as music, visual arts, and storytelling through non-formal education.
Tasks:
Assist with theater-based activities
Prepare visual art classes, 
Exploring music through rhythm, melody, and group play.
Facilitate storytelling and creative writing activities to boost imagination and language skills.
Offer encouragement and support to shy or hesitant participants through a positive environment for them to feel comfortable.
Assist the children with their homework
Work alongside staff and other volunteers to foster a supportive, inclusive environment.

The volunteers will be lodged at an apartment specifically dedicated to their hosting. (max. 3 people/ room).
The apartment is very close to the Center Pinocchio.
Volunteers will be provided with monthly food allowance for their grocery shopping together with a pocket money of 4 Euro for each day of service.

The participant will engage in non formal education activities with the support of our teacher and other staff members.
The participant will also be in close contact with our mentor, to ensure that the experience matches his/her expectations.
The national agency is providing an On Arrival Training and a Mid-term evaluation.

We are searching for young people with a strong interest in ensuring the rights of the most disadvantaged groups and with a big passion for volunteering.

Reliability, critical thinking and availability are some of the qualities we are searching for in a participant, along with a willingness to work in a culturally diverse group and with a desire for self growth and for contributing to other people's growth.

Make a real difference, share smiles, and gain unique experiences while supporting people in their daily lives.

- Pocket money: 7 EUR/day 💰

- Travel covered: Flights & daily commute ✈️🚗

Focus on the adventure, the experience, and making a real difference! 🌟

• Build unforgettable experiences and friendships 🤝

💛 Are You Ready to Volunteer at Siloe?

If you’re between 18 and 30, open-hearted, eager to grow your professional skills, and excited to embrace new experiences, this project is made for you! 🌟

We’re looking for volunteers who are proactive, motivated to learn Czech, and can work independently while being a great team player. Flexibility, good time management, empathy, and a non-judgmental approach are essential. Awareness of Alzheimer’s or vascular dementia is a plus, and previous experience with seniors is welcome. 🌈

Step in, share your energy, and help make meaningful moments in the lives of elderly people every day.

👉 Learn more: www.intervia.cz

You will spend your days with children in primary school (1st graders) and during school break with children in kindergarten (children aged 4-6), every day while parents are at work. Together with 2 teachers in your daily routine you will assist during the regular class hours and help lead sports, language, math, social and nature science, music, design lessons, and in kindergarten also assist play-time in and out-doors, organize visits to other institutions to expand horizon of kids, organize activities for staff, etc. You are invited to be active and come up with Your own creative ideas and develop little concepts of play and projects of Your own initiative. Children of this kindergarten and primary school have special needs and some have disabilities. 
Valmiera city with nearly 30’000 inhabitants is the economic center of Valmiera county and one of the major cities in Northern Latvia. While it is not too big in European context, it provides all services one might need.

Accommodation is provided in a rental apartment in the center of Valmiera, shared with other volunteers (can be two same-gender persons per room). Each volunteer is provided with a Latvian phone number and a fast internet plan. A city bus card is provided based on actual needs.
Food allowance of €7 per day is provided for meals or groceries. In addition, the kindergarten and Gaujas Krasta School provide one hot lunch daily for their staff.
Volunteers also receive additional pocket money of €5 per day.
Duration of volunteering activity is flexible (3-12 months).

-Pre-departure training on cultural differences, living abroad, volunteer support during mobility, responsibilities, and ESC guidelines will be provided by the sending organization in the volunteer’s home country.
-On-arrival and mid-term training will be organized by the National Agency in Latvia.

Join the European Solidarity Corps at la Ligue de l’enseignement de Normandie, a civic organization in France. You’ll support projects that fight discrimination and promote equality.

• Read and summarise key information from these documents.
• Raise awareness of the rights to education, work and human rights.
• Participate in the preparation of Useful Holidays, especially in raising awareness of the right to education for 150 children.
• Optionally, support retaining wall construction activities and other initiatives of the association (sales, fairs, etc.).

The volunteers will be actively embedded in the multiethnic and stimulating environment of Bologna by exploiting the activities and the network of contacts of IFOM. They will be involved in activities connected with the promotion of EU values between young people and adults. The volunteers will be involved in supporting the implementation of learning mobilities activities addressing European students coming to Italy or going abroad for vocational practice (VET-Vocational and Educational Training). Volunteers will support the activities from a logistic and networking point of view. The volunteers will support the team with translations, documents preparation, cultural visits in other cities and accompanying students and teachers during the visits in working places.
Together with other volunteers, they will be involved in organisation and implementation of the local activities such as workshops in the schools and linguistic tandems (in person and online).

The volunteer will share the room with another volunteer (same gender) in a flat with all facilities, shared with other international volunteers. The flat is composed by 2 double bedrooms, 1 toilet, small kitchen and dining room. There are wi-fi and a washing machine.
The volunteers will have a monthly food allowance to buy food and basic needs. The volunteers will cook their own meals.
The volunteer will have available a monthly or annual bus ticket for the city of Bologna.

General Online Training, Linguistic support, Pre-departure training, On-arrival training, Mid-term evaluation, Annual European Solidarity Corps events. Volunteers will attend training with non-formal methods about the development of soft skills.

We are looking for motivated and active volunteers, willing to stay for the entire period of the project.
*The Polish-speaking candidates will have the priority in the selection.

As a volunteer, you’ll be at the heart of something special — helping caregivers and bringing daily joy to our guests! Your efforts will help create a lively atmosphere that everyone will enjoy. Here's a sneak peek at what you'll get up to:
Your Key Responsibilities: activity Prep: get creative and help gather all the materials we need to make weekly activities awesome! Teaming up with caregivers: work hand-in-hand with caregivers to host different workshops+activities, like cooking classes, digital storytelling, board games, music jams, tech sessions, outings in the local community. Social Media savvy: put your social media skills to use by creating cool posts and stories to showcase all the fun we’re having — and share our latest events and activities! Training vibes: dive into training sessions packed with insider knowledge for volunteers — learn from the pros and level up your skills.  ESC promotion: spread the word about ESC and help prepare Italian volunteers heading out.

As a volunteer, you’ll be living in a super modern, newly-furnished flat with 4 other amazing volunteers from all over the world, right in the heart of Pordenone! It’s just a short walk away from the organization where you’ll be working. The accommodation will be provided in a single or double room with a shared bathroom and kitchen. You will receive  6,00€ pocket money per day and a monthly extra 190€ as food money if you prepare all your meals. In this way you are free to cook in your fully equipped flat. You can get a bike under the deposit of 40€.

As a volunteer, you’ll get the chance to join a dynamic training cycle organized by the Italian National Agency, where you'll dive into everything from hands-on activities to personal development.
You’ll also have the chance to take an Italian language course – October to June. You will get trained in running educational and relational workshops! You will learn by doing.

We’re looking for motivated, proactive, and passionate people who are ready to dive into something meaningful! As a volunteer, you’ll need to bring your A-game, but also be ready to learn, grow, and adapt. Here's what you should bring to the table:
Key traits we value: responsibility & motivation, patience & flexibility as working with people with disabilities means being understanding and adaptable to change.
Curiosity & positivity: willing and happy to learn, whether it’s the Italian language or new ways to connect with others.
Respect & sensitivity: it is important to understand the importance of being respectful and sensitive in diverse social environments.
Team Spirit: in the social field it's vital to be able to work together with others.
Passion for people: whether it’s running workshops or simply supporting others, you’re driven to make an impact.
Living in Italy: you’ll need to be pumped about living in Italy, immersing yourself in the culture, and adapting to your new environment.
Sharing a flat or live in a host family: you’ll either share a flat with other young Europeans or live with a local host family, so being adaptable and respectful of house rules is key.
ESC is a full-time learning journey. It’s all about getting involved, making a real difference in other people life.

You 4 Youth is a 10-month volunteering experience in Grottaminarda, supporting Cripta Maynarda in expanding its cultural and social activities. With the help of two volunteers, the project aims to strengthen partnerships and promote volunteering as a tool for community cohesion, solidarity, and active citizenship.
Part of You 4 Youth, this initiative encourages young people to take an active role in cultural and social life, fighting social apathy and youth marginalization.

Personal storage space, including a wardrobe, bedside table, and desk with a lamp.

✅ Organize cultural events to engage and inspire other youth.

We are looking for young people who would like to help us organize cultural and/or educational events at our cultural centre and who are willing to help us with maintenance of a cultural centre. We regularly host cultural and educational events of various forms and at the same time we participate in the community life of our town. We expect volunteers to be an active part of our activities and even to come up with new events / activites if they are interested. We will appreciate it if they are curious and eager to learn new things (preparation of sound technique and lights for events, preparation of posters, etc.) and at the same time they will help us with daily tasks, e.g. posts at social networks, photos from events, selling tickets at events, help with seats for viewers, accomodate our guests, help with the maintenance of the building, etc. We are a dynamic place that became a centre of independent culture of our region. Moreover, Rožňava is surrounded by beautiful nature.

Volunteers will be accomodated in the accomodation premises of our cultural centre. We run a vegetarian restaurant at our cultural centre so volunteers can eat lunch right here. Our cultural centre is located in the historical centre of our town (Rožňava, Slovakia), close to several restaurants and shops. The closest supermarket is 500 m away from our place. One can get to Rožňava by bus or train, Rožňava is located 1 hour by car/bus/train from Košice, the second largest Slovak city, with an international airport (good connections for example with Prague, Vienna, Warsaw or London).

Volunteers will have a chance to learn the basics of the Slovak language. As our cultural centre organizes various cultural and educational events (concerts, public readings, exhibitions, workshops, theatre performances, etc.), volunteers will have a chance to learn a lot about how a cultural centre works, how events are organized. Volunteers will also be able to organize events of their own if they are interested. At the same time we expect them to be involved in our Language Café event (foreign langueges speaking tables), where they will be able to get to know people from our community.

A young person willing to volunteer at an independent cultural creative centre located in the bulding of a former franciscan monastery in a small Slovak town (Roznava) in an interesting historical region (Gemer) full of monuments and natural beauties, where he/she can actively contribute to the shaping of the project, learn lots of new things, and even come up with brand new activities and events organized for our audience.

This long-term ESC project is looking for 3 motivated volunteers. Hosted by Città Solidale, a social cooperative in Vicenza (northern Italy, near Venice), the project runs from September 2025 to September 2026. Volunteers must be available for the full duration.

Città Solidale works with people with disabilities in residential communities, aiming to improve their quality of life and support autonomy and well-being. The organization offers both health assistance and personal/social development.

Volunteers will support either an educational community (working with people with mild mental disabilities on personalized projects) or two assisted living communities (helping residents in daily and leisure activities and building interpersonal relationships, often beyond verbal communication).

Volunteers will be hosted in shared apartment in Vicenza, well connected by public transport. Each volunteer will have their own room, while the bathroom and kitchen are shared. 

Each volunteer will receive: 

A monthly allowance of 150€ for personal expenses 

ESC pocket money of 6€ per day 

Round-trip international travel covered according to the ESC distance bands (211€ for 100–499 km; 309€ for 500–1999 km) 

A bicycle and public transport tickets for local mobility 

Possible coverage of costs for the residence permit application and visa request

On-arrival training (1 week) 

Mid-term evaluation (4 days) 

Italian language course (3 hours per week) 

Workshops on social and environmental topics 

Training on being a European volunteer 

Introduction to the third sector in Italy, including what it means to be part of a cooperative

We are looking for open-minded, empathetic, and motivated volunteers who are ready to spend 12 months in a foreign country working with people with disabilities and experiencing life in a social community. 

We particularly welcome candidates with a strong motivation to explore the field of social work and a genuine interest in spending time with the beneficiaries, participating in their daily activities, and supporting them through both practical and relational tasks. 

Flexibility, patience, and willingness to adapt to a new environment are essential. Previous experience — even informal or as a volunteer — in the social field is appreciated but not mandatory. 

A basic knowledge of Italian or at least of English is required to facilitate communication and integration.
