full_description:
Boskanter is a place where people can experience and experiments with ways of living that are less dependent on fossil fuels and more resilient. By letting people experience a regenerative alternative, we broaden the scope of alternatives, reduce fear and create hope and courage to consider the radical changes that need to be made in the world, rather than criticizing the current system and people trapped in it.
Volunteers learn to manage the place and to host short term volunteers and visitors. They try to master some skills related to 'living of the land'. They inspire visitors and short term volunteers with this life and even try to teach them (some of) what they learned. They help to organize activities for the neighborhood.
Workdays start with a meeting at eight, and are flexibly adapted to work and needs of participants.
The project exists of two farms at 8 km distance, in the Flemish part of Belgium, each inhabited by a family with two teenage kids and some volunteers.

You stay on the farm in a private, not heated room. There is a wood stove-heated communal kitchen/living room, dry toilets, a sun-heated outdoor shower in summer and stove heated warm water to use in a tub or the sauna in winter. The (rain)water supply is limited, so showering is functional. There is electricity, WIFI and a laundry machine. You share the cooking and meals with the families. The food is included, local, organic, seasonal, mostly vegetarian and home-processed. You can take food on free days. 2€50 per project day is given to cover local transport and other excursion costs.

We teach you the skills you need to work on the farm such as scything, mulching, splitting and storing wood, taking care of the animals, processing food, making  and using natural paint and cob, making sourdough bread in the wood-oven, cook on a rocket stove, … . You are encouraged to also learn crafts such as carving wood, spinning, making baskets, making poaches from recuperation leather etc, so you can inspire and teach visitors and other volunteers. What you learn will depend on ongoing projects and your skills and interests.
The language is mainly English.

We look for volunteers that search a place where they can try out simple(r) living close to nature, with like-minded people, because they are worried about the destruction of the ecosystem and want to explore how to act or how to live.  
Don’t expect a fully operating self-sufficient system, though. We are small, we’re still part of this world and sharing this life with others limits our efficiency. You help with what we are currently doing. Together we decide what extra projects to focus on during your stay.
We accept no drugs or smoking. Alcohol is limited to special occasions.

ICYE Brazil invites young European volunteers to join the SASID Project, a Humanitarian Aid ESC initiative. This program offers a 10-month voluntary experience with the Umbúntu social project in a poor district of Alvorada city. Umbúntu provides a community and cultural space with workshops on topics like edible plant processing, handicrafts, capoeira, percussion, and language teaching. Volunteers will participate in and lead these workshops using non-formal education methods, fostering a rich intercultural learning environment. But volunteers will also have a hands-on experience in environmentally sustainable practices by participating in farming, permaculture gardening, construction and other manual activities of our project. The main aims are to provide humanitarian aid, raise awareness about climate change and encourage discussions on green alternatives. Join us now!

Umbúntu’s focus on organic produce allows volunteers to enjoy and prepare healthy food. Park Istra will host up to 16 volunteers for the 'Solidarity in Primorska' project, starting on February 18, 2025, for a duration of two months. Volunteers will engage in a range of meaningful activities, such as helping people in need with renovation work, supporting local communities and NGOs, assisting farmers and working with children and elderly care homes. If you're looking to make a positive impact, develop new skills, and work alongside volunteers from across Europe, our volunteer center offers a unique opportunity. In 2021, this project was honored with a nomination as one of Europe’s top five volunteering projects by the Salto Awards.

Volunteers will be staying at the volunteer center in the village of Kastelec. The center offers shared accommodations for up to 16 volunteers. Facilities include shared bathrooms with toilets and showers, a large kitchen, a living room, a relaxation space, and beautiful surroundings. Just behind the house, there’s a basketball court, trampoline, firepit and slackline. Volunteers will prepare three vegetarian meals together daily. The project covers travel expenses, accommodation, food, insurance and provides a daily allowance of €5. The coastal city of Koper is just a 10-minute drive away.

At Park Istra, you will have the full support of both a work coordinator and a personal mentor. In your free time, we enjoy sharing knowledge, playing social games, walking on the slackline, swimming, rock climbing (with excellent climbing spots nearby), and playing volleyball or basketball. We also take time to read, watch movies, chat, and explore the beauty of Slovenia. The surrounding region of Istria is perfect for hiking, biking, and climbing. It’s also renowned as one of Europe’s top destinations for culinary experiences.

Park Istra invites volunteers who are eager to engage in various areas related to sustainability, environmental protection, charity, and education. Keep in mind that many of our tasks are hands-on, including light renovation, farming, and maintaining trekking paths, so come prepared to get your hands dirty. We value a strong motivation to help others, and volunteers with fewer opportunities will be given preference. Please apply online through EU Youth Portal and fill in application form on this link: https://forms.gle/rbeT5E5weLXisPJR7

full_description:
For many people, permaculture mainly means caring about the garden and plants. Permaculture however is a wider concept that includes in addition to earth care, caring about the people and their needs. It is based on relationships that should grow and support each other. Growing inside can be approached either in a philosophical, emotional, or mental way in our vision and understanding of the world. Growing outside can be related to gardening, relationships, nature, or our skills. Perma comes from permanent –something that can be sustainable. Culture is a complex of specific spiritual, material, intellectual and emotional traits of a society or social group, which also includes a common way of life, lifestyle, value system, traditions, and faith. We will explore together “What is perma-Culture?” not only in a material way, but also in philosophical, social, and also personal way.

We have a separated part of our house with two bedrooms, kitchen, bathroom and toilet, where we can accommodate four persons. This part of the house will be the volunteers accommodation. Both places are independently separated. Volunteers have their own kitchen. In the village there is a small grocery store, there is a school kitchen with reasonable prices, and there is the option of food delivery. Usually they are going to the nearby town to do bigger shopping trips in a supermarket and we share cooking by our selfs.

On-arrival and mid-term training are provided by Slovak NA. The organization provide teachings about Permaculture, Dragon Dreaming project management, pottery and woodcraft workshops and many other small or big things needed for live in rural area.

Suitable for volunteers who are looking for living and working in a rural area connected with nature and community, willing to participate actively in all the process, and learn in a wide range of activities ready to work physically and be responsible for the duties and agreements. They should feel concerned about climate change issues and are willing to learn and live responsibly. We appreciate it if volunteers have some manual skills of using working tools, or other skills needed in rural areas, but it is not required. However some preconditions for rural and community life is needed.

The volunteer will support the organization’s communication and visibility work, helping to document and share the daily life of the foundation. Tasks include creating social media content, taking photos and videos, writing short articles for the foundation’s daily journal, and designing materials for campaigns and internal communication. In addition to communication-related tasks, the volunteer will also participate in the foundation’s daily activities connected to social inclusion — such as community events, workshops, and activities with residents. Creativity, empathy, and teamwork are essential, as well as basic skills in digital communication or design. This role combines technical learning with meaningful social engagement, promoting human connection and inclusive storytelling.

Volunteers are hosted in a shared house located within the foundation. Rooms are shared with other volunteer, encouraging community life and cultural exchange. Breakfast and lunch are provided collectively during the week, while dinners and weekend meals are self-managed. There is no weekly cleaning service; household tasks are shared among residents. Local transport costs related to project activities are covered, while personal expenses remain the volunteer’s responsibility.

Volunteers will receive ongoing learning and guidance through non-formal education methods. They will be introduced to the foundation’s work in social inclusion and supported step by step in their daily tasks. Regular mentoring sessions, reflection meetings, and intercultural exchanges promote both personal and professional growth. Volunteers may also join local or European workshops to develop communication, creativity, and teamwork skills useful for their future paths.

We are looking for a motivated and creative volunteer interested in communication, social inclusion, and community life. The ideal participant enjoys photography, writing, or social media and wants to use these tools to tell meaningful stories. Sensitivity, empathy, and teamwork are essential, as well as an interest in working alongside people from diverse backgrounds. Basic knowledge of English or Spanish is required. The volunteer should be open-minded, flexible, and eager to learn in an intercultural and socially engaged environment.

Implemented by CIVS Kenya, this initiative takes place at the Resource Centers in Nyakach and Kuth Awendo, located in the Kano Plains of Kisumu County. In this region, many families rely on agriculture for their livelihoods but face recurring challenges from seasonal flooding that threaten food security and economic stability. As a volunteer, you will work alongside community members to raise awareness on climate change adaptation, promote climate-smart agriculture, and lead tree planting initiatives that help restore degraded land and reduce the impact of flooding. You’ll also support community workshops and school outreach activities that teach youth and adults about sustainable land use, soil and water conservation, and environmental stewardship—empowering local communities to build a more resilient and sustainable future.

Accommodation will be arranged at a shared rented flat within the region with a bathroom and toilet. CIVS will furnish the room with a few pieces of furniture and basic equipment for the kitchen and bathroom. The apartment will have electricity and water, though volunteers may on some occasions experience disruptions of these services.  Volunteers will be taught how to clean their own clothes using their hands by our local mentors. Volunteers will prepare their own meals at the apartment. Transport to the projects is by motorcycle. Transport to the market, and to Kisumu City is by public vans.

This opportunity is part of the BRIDGE project (Building Resilience, Innovation, Development and Gender Equality), in which volunteers will have the chance to work on a common objective: empowerment and skills development of vulnerable communities, with a focus on women groups and enhance digital skills, participate in UN Women Summits and animating digital workshops. Visit: https://mondo.org.ee/en/volunteers/

Environment Expert should have a basic understanding of climate change, floods, and their effects on local communities and ecosystems. They should know how rainfall, rivers, and terrain contribute to flooding and be able to suggest farming methods suited to flood-prone areas. Strong community engagement skills are essential, including the ability to raise awareness about environmental conservation, waste management, and flood preparedness. The role requires adaptability to rural conditions and a hands-on attitude for tasks like tree planting, soil movement, and farm work. Experience in farming, tree planting, and promoting sustainable land use is highly valuable for this position.

Candidates must be 18 to 35 years old, reside in one of the eligible countries (EU Member State, North Macedonia, Iceland, Liechtenstein or Turkey), have completed the compulsory Humanitarian Aid Volunteering training and not have participated before in individual Humanitarian Aid Volunteering. When adding together this new volunteering opportunity and any previous participation in EU volunteering programmes, the total duration cannot exceed 12 months.

Offer opportunities for volunteers across the EU to positively impact refugee populations through support and activities at refugee settings in greater Athens
Volunteers will participate in CHEERing Grow Clinics, support refugee visits to dental clinics, perform screenings in public health and related activities, help make referrals to vaccination programs, work on distribution of hygiene and fundamental distribution items, and offer support in group activities such as football, swimming lessons, and excursions.

Individual volunteering for December and onwards: Are you eager to help us out with our daily activities at a unique off-grid location, where you can develop practical skills in animal care, renovation, and green maintenance? Want to try something out of your comfort zone? This is a project for those who love practical outdoor work, aren't afraid to get their hands dirty, and have a go-getter mentality with a proactive attitude. We place a strong emphasis on sustainable living. Our animal family includes 2 cows, 5 horses used for coaching with the homeless, sheep, 2 pigs, chickens, geese, an aviary, 2 dogs, and a cat. The tasks are physically demanding, and the weather can be challenging in the Netherlands.

The accommodation is at BioArt Village, a beautiful location surrounded by a forest inside the city of Eindhoven. The place is off-grid, fulfilling basic needs, and participants must approach this with a non-wasteful mindset. Common areas include the bathroom, kitchen, and living room. In addition to pocket money, you also receive food money, so basic cooking skills are necessary. The center and shops are around 20 minutes by bike. Airport is nearby.

Our project offers multiple durations, so there is something for everyone. We provide short-term volunteering with a minimum duration of two months, and long-term volunteering when possible (up to 6 months). During your time assisting us in developing BioArt Village, you'll have the opportunity to learn more about renovation, animal care, permaculture gardening, and green maintenance. Training in these areas will be provided during the activity.

We are looking for volunteers who are interested in nature, like physical outdoor work, and who embrace living off-grid. They should be ready to tackle challenges, capable of daily sustainable animal care, outdoor work, and assisting with restoring the area. Participants are able to work independently and effectively as team players. A positive attitude and strong motivation are essential. We encourage individuals with fewer opportunities to apply, and understanding and living sustainably with limited resources is crucial.  Please note that participants must be in good mental and physical health to perform the required tasks and commit to staying in the program for its entire duration.

ENGIM has been operating in Ecuador since 2005 with the aim of promoting the integral development of communities in vulnerable situations. - Strengthening relationships and collaboration with beneficiary communities;

A monthly allowance of €800 will be provided, covering daily expenses, food and local transport.
A laptop will be provided, and reimbursement for mobile phone expenses is included.

This project aims to engage young people in meaningful activities that combine education, sport, and environmental awareness. The "Seeds of Change: Sustainable Development through Volunteering" (SDV) project is a 24-month initiative that integrates environmental sustainability and disaster risk reduction through community-based approaches. Leveraging the expertise of our consortium, the project focuses on environmental education, risk mitigation, and sustainable development practices. ENGIM, in collaboration with UDAPT (Unión de Afectados y Afectadas por las Operaciones Petroleras de Texaco), work on environmental monitoring in rural communities of Sucumbíos. The project aims to document and analyze pollution levels and assess the socio-environmental impact of extractive industries.

Main tasks:
- Conduct environmental monitoring activities in collaboration with local communities
- Collect and analyze environmental data
- Develop georeferenced reports and graphical representations of environmental degradation (GIS software, mapping tools)
- Document environmental grievances and collect testimonies on pollution-related health and livelihood impacts
- Organize community workshops on environmental awareness and advocacy strategies

- Education & Training: Degree in Environmental Science, Geography, Social Sciences, or related fields. Additional training in GIS, environmental monitoring, or community advocacy is an asset.

- Candidates must be 18 to 35 years old, reside in one of the eligible countries (EU Member State, North Macedonia, Iceland, Liechtenstein or Turkey), have completed the compulsory Humanitarian Aid Volunteering training and not have participated before in individual Humanitarian Aid Volunteering. full_description:
Le Suncokret Center for Community Development est un centre de bénévolat local et à la fois un centre communautaire dans une belle région rurale d’après-guerre.  

Le centre propose des activités d’apprentissage non formel après l’école pour les enfants et les jeunes de la communauté ; des activités éducatives, du tutorat, de l’aide aux devoirs, de l’artisanat, des jeux, des sports, des ateliers ludiques et créatifs. Ils organisent également des activités de sensibilisation à l’environnement, des ateliers sur la durabilité, du jardinage écologique, de l’entretien des jardins et vergers biologiques ainsi que des activités d’écoconstruction.

Le·la volontaire bénéficiera de : • une indemnité mensuelle (argent de poche et alimentation) + assurance pendant la mission + prise en charge des frais de voyage (selon le forfait kilométrique). • un appartement partagé avec d'autres volontaires, pris en charge, avec chambres individuelles

Un suivi par un tuteur local et des formations (préparation au départ, formations internes pendant la mission et vie en commun avec d'autres volontaires de différents pays).

Le volontaire doit être intéressé par l'animation avec les enfants et les jeunes (arts et artisanat, sports, musique, danse, jeux, apprentissage non formel, ateliers, etc.) ainsi que par des activités d’inclusion sociale, activités de sensibilisation à l’environnement et à la durabilité, à l’éco-jardinage et bien plus encore.

L'organizzazione d'accoglienza utilizza il baseball per sostenere lo sviluppo di bambini dai 4 ai 16 anni, per far loro acquisire attraverso la pratica sportiva le competenze e la sicurezza necessarie per affrontare qualsiasi sfida. Obiettivo del progetto è promuovere una mentalità sana, fondamentale per il successo, utilizzando metodi di coaching positivo per aumentare la felicità, l'ottimismo e la resilienza. T'immergerai nell'entusiasmante mondo dello sport e degli eventi sportivi per bambini, lavorando a contatto con gli allenatori e  assistendoli nelle attività quotidiane e nelle sessioni d'allenamento. Sarai d'aiuto anche in vari aspetti dei progetti con scuole, asili e istituzioni sociali. I tuoi cómpiti spazieranno dall'aiuto nella logistica, all'organizzazione di eventi e alla gestione del lavoro amministrativo, fino alla cattura di momenti straordinari attraverso la fotografia e al rafforzamento della presenza della scuola di baseball sui social media.

Alloggerai in stanza singola, in un appartamento o in uno studentato: non sarà lussuosa, ma soddisferà le tue esigenze di base. Tuttavia potrebbe non esserci internet. Riceverai un'indennità per le tue spese personali che in Austria è di 7 euro al giorno. Il vitto ti sarà fornito dall'organizzazione d'accoglienza, oppure riceverai a questo scopo una seconda indennità mensile fino a 250 euro. Il viaggio d'andata e ritorno dall'Italia all'Austria ti sarà totalmente rimborsato, e riceverai un abbonamento mensile  valido per tutti i trasporti pubblici locali. È anche prevista un'assicurazione.

Parteciperai a 3 sessioni di formazione ufficiali: una prima della partenza dall'Italia, una seconda qualche settimana dopo il tuo arrivo in Austria e una terza verso la fine del volontariato. Riceverai un supporto economico per frequentare un corso di Tedesco a tua scelta. L'organizzazione di coordinamento ti metterà in contatto con tanti altri giovani di vari paesi d'Europa che partecipano ad altri progetti, e con i quali avrai l'opportunità d'assistere a tante altre attività formative "interne", ma anche socializzare e fare nuove amicizie. Sarà un'esperienza bellissima!!

Il volontario ideale per questo progetto è una persona motivata ed energica, che ama lavorare con i bambini ed è interessata allo sport, alla gestione d'eventi sportivi e alla comunicazione. Non sono richieste esperienze pregresse o conoscenze particolari rispetto al baseball, che comunque costituiranno un vantaggio in caso di parità d'altri criteri. Allo stesso modo, la padronanza d'un livello base di Tedesco, Inglese o Spagnolo potrebbe costituire un plus in caso di parità. Se stai pensando di candidarti, osserva bene le date d'inizio e fine del progetto, che sono precise e molto distanti nel tempo: procedi con la presentazione del tuo profilo solo se davvero sei intenzionato a svolgere un periodo di volontariato che non inizia prima di maggio 2026! E ricorda che tutto il materiale che metti a disposizione per supportare la tua candidatura dev'essere in Inglese (o in Tedesco, se lo parli.....).

Stranaidea, ente di invio italiano, propone questo progetto per l’ente ospitante Fundacja Prom: in asili pubblici con bambini d'età compresa tra 3 e 6 anni come assistente insegnante, con compiti come: supportare nelle attività di cura dei bambini, in quelle d'auto-aiuto come vestirsi e mangiare, durante lezioni didattiche o attività all'aperto come i giochi nel giardino o le gite scolastiche; far conoscere l'Italia attraverso presentazioni ed eventi per bambini e genitori; creare laboratori d'arte e artigianato in base ai tuoi interessi e alle tue competenze; insegnare lingue straniere (come Italiano o Inglese); portare le tue idee per migliorare l'estetica dei locali dell'asilo. Avrai anche la possibilità di fare esperienze di supporto didattico. Organizzerai e parteciperai a eventi che diffondono i valori dell'ESC e i contenuti del tuo volontariato nella comunità locale, durante picnic, fiere, feste di quartiere e attraverso trasmissioni radiofoniche.

Sarai ospitato in stanza doppia, in un appartamento condiviso con altri volontari o studenti (circa 5 persone in un appartamento). Cucina e bagno sono condivisi con i coinquilini. Gli appartamenti hanno Internet, l'attrezzatura di base per cucinare, asciugamani e un set di biancheria da letto. Riceverai un sussidio mensile di 130 euro per acquistare cibo, e un secondo sussidio mensile per le spese personali (150 euro); i costi di trasporto locale sono coperti dal progetto. Il viaggio dall'Italia alla Polonia e ritorno è completamente rimborsato e sei coperto da un'assicurazione.

Durante la prima settimana, i volontari parteciperanno a una formazione con un coordinatore del progetto. Impareranno il volontariato e le regole di convivenza, i metodi di lavoro con i bambini, le norme di sicurezza, l'assicurazione sanitaria UE e un'assicurazione complementare, riceveranno un utile vocabolario di base in lingua polacca e parteciperanno a divertenti attività di team building. La formazione all'arrivo e a metà progetto si svolgerà all'inizio e a metà del progetto. Le lezioni di polacco dureranno almeno 2-3 mesi e la partecipazione è obbligatoria.

Ti piace lavorare con i bambini e possiedi buone capacità organizzative e non hai paura di lavorare con grandi gruppi o di vivere all'estero per molto tempo. C'è bisogno che tu sia responsabile, affidabile e motivato, ma allo stesso tempo amichevole, flessibile, attivo e disponibile, aperto a imparare cose nuove e ad accettare nuove culture, pronto a imparare le basi del Polacco e a collaborare con la comunità locale. Creatività e immaginazione completano il tuo profilo. Dovresti parlare un inglese comunicativo e preferibilmente avere avuto precedenti esperienze simili con bambini (come scout o babysitter). Attenzione: ricordati che tutto il materiale che metti a disposizione per sostenere la tua candidatura deve essere in inglese (o in polacco...). Verrà chiesto di compilare un form, si trova nell'infopack che riceverai in seguito alla candidatura.

BASIDA, a non-profit, charitable and welfare association, declared of Public Utility, has been working since 1990 through its Shelter Houses, with the general objective of providing free shelter and care from a biopsychosocial point of view for people with serious social and health problems, who are in a situation of social exclusion, providing them with comprehensive, personalised and interdisciplinary care and assistance based on quality. The profile of the people assisted at BASIDA has diversified and nowadays, we attend to chronically ill people, people with addiction problems - mainly to alcohol, drugs and other substances, elderly people with dementia and chronic illnesses that require specialised and continuous care that their families cannot provide, former prisoners on parole due to serious and incurable illnesses and families in a situation of vulnerability or social exclusion. The project includes courses o acquire technical knowledge and skills for the residents

The 12ha. house is  9 km from the centre of Aranjuez, 47 km from  Madrid,  has adequate  facilities for the proper development of its projects: buildings for residents, volunteers, offices, plus a multi-sports court with football, tennis, volleyball and basketball courts, a swimming pool, a chapel-oratory, gardens, children's playground, gymnasium and cultivation field.
Long-term volunteers are offered a shared double room with en-suite bathroom in a two-storey building.On the ground floor there is a laundry-cum-cloakroom-cum-sewing room, and a multi-purpose room for games, rehabilitation gym

Volunteers will be trainned to carry out the following activities:
- Care for sick and bedridden people.
- Support in physical rehabilitation and occupational therapy activities for cognitive rehabilitation
- Participation in workshops (carpentry, gardening, painting, etc.)
- Participation in the educational department: adult literacy workshop, after-school support 
- Organisation of workshops and occupational activities: magazine, theatre, computer, yoga and relaxation, sports activities, etc.
- Organisation of workshops and leisure time activities (excursions, cultural activities, etc)

This is a Long Term Porject for no less than 6 months, preferably one year. The characteristics of the volunteers who collaborate in our organisation are as follows:
 People of either sex, from different European countries and of any culture, race or religion.
 People with a minimum level of maturity, sensitised and interested in learning about the problems posed by HIV/AIDS and drug addiction, and in sharing experiences with these groups. They should also be motivated to learn or improve their language skills and get to know Spanish culture.

To fully apply and be considered as a candidate, please read all the information on our webpage and fill out the application form you will find on fincaluna.org
The program offers a 10 months experience in 2 different farms. You will learn and practice about sintropic agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, and permaculture design. It includes intense physical work, theory workshops and a multicultural volunteer community experience, all with a focus on learning by doing. You will share this experience in groups of 2 in each farm during 4 months, and then with a group of 6 volunteers in another farm during 6 months. It is a long term program to allow you to deepen the concepts you learn and to see the evolution of your practice and abilities. Volunteers come from different countries, included from Spain. We work 7 hours daily ranging from routine farm work (garden, forest, animals, plant nursery, bioconstruction), group projects, workshops, and community work in other farms.

Volunteers are hosted in the farms, in shared bedrooms, with access to shared bathroom and kitchen. Comfort is basic as some facilities are located outside . In winter, rain is frequent and temperature can go down to -2 degrees celsius by night (it can be cold inside too because of humidity). This is probably not the image you have of Canary Island but farms are located in mountain areas, not on the coast! In summer, we work with 35-37 degrees. Food is covered partially by farm produces, partially by money allowance to buy products in the market. Meals are cooked and shared among volunteers.

The aim of our project is to train you so that you can improve your awareness of the natural environment, have a good understanding of what regenerative agriculture is, design and build your own food forest, and become leader of sustainability in your community. We focus on learning by doing, where mistakes are part of the process. Our goal is that you enhance your confidence and autonomy in conducting ecological farm tasks. Volunteers are trained through workshops offered by the coordinators as well as by fellow volunteers.

To be passionate about the environment, ecological farming, and permaculture; To be willing to learn rural and manual skills and to enjoy doing physical hard work; To be ready to spend 10 months living and working on a farm with basic comfort with cold rainy weather in winter and dry and hot in summer; To be willing to study the theory behind regenerative agriculture and permaculture; To be open-minded, flexible and have predisposition to learning; ready to participate in maintenance activities such as cooking and cleaning; To be committed to learn basic spanish before arrival. Preference will be given to candidates with fewer opportunities. If you want to combine volunteering with vacations life style, this is not for you. Apply only if you are passionate about our topics and want to become a regenerative farmer in the future.

Volunteers will actively engage in scientific research by collecting data related to flora and fauna, ecosystemic characteristics, climate change, and cultural heritage elements. Through these tasks, volunteers play a vital role in preserving and protecting local ecosystems, and mitigating the impacts of climate change. Volunteers will also contribute to the preservation of cultural heritage through archival research, and community engagement events. In questo volontariato le tue mansioni principali includono: assistere nella pianificazione, implementazione e monitoraggio dei progetti dell'organizzazione d'accoglienza; partecipare alle riunioni di gruppo e contribuire alle discussioni sui progetti; supportare la preparazione di reports di progetto, verbali di riunione e presentazioni; supportare la logistica (allestimento della sede, preparazione dei materiali, accoglienza dei partecipanti) per gli eventi collegati ai progetti; supportare la ricerca di nuove proposte di progetto e opportunità di finanziamento; assistere nella preparazione delle candidature e della documentazione per le attività del programma Erasmus+ o d'altri programmi europei; promuovere i programmi europei (Corpo Europeo di Solidarietà e l'Erasmus+)  presso scuole e luoghi pubblici. L'obiettivo di questi progetti è migliorare il funzionamento democratico attraverso la partecipazione, il lavoro e la mobilità giovanile, e i giovani ne sono i protagonisti.

Alloggerai in una casa fornita di tutto il necessario, compreso internet, in stanza doppia o singola a seconda della composizione dei volontari presenti. L'appartamento è ubicato nella zona centrale di Portimão, a poca distanza dalla sede di lavoro. Ogni mese riceverai un'indennità di 310 euro per pagare le tue spese alimentari e quelle personali. Il viaggio dall'Italia al Portogallo e ritorno ti sarà completamente rimborsato, così come i trasporti locali e quelli connessi al progetto. È prevista anche un'assicurazione convenzionata con l'Unione Europea che ti coprirà da infortuni e malattie.

Parteciperai a 3 sessioni di formazione ufficiali: una prima di lasciare l'Italia, una seconda poche settimane dopo il tuo arrivo in Portogallo e una terza dopo la metà del tuo volontariato. A Portimão l'organizzazione d'accoglienza ti coinvolgerà in altre attività formative, compreso un corso di Portoghese, che ti permetteranno d'acquisire informazioni sulle specificità del progetto in cui sei inserito, e il suo staff sarà sempre attento a valutare assieme a te l'andamento del tuo volontariato. Avrai anche l'opportunità di conoscere tanti altri ragazzi europei: sarà un'esperienza bellissima!

Cerchiamo un giovane motivato e desideroso d'imparare cose nuove, e ovviamente interessato ai progetti europei, alla comunicazione e alla partecipazione giovanile. Non è richiesta una particolare esperienza pregressa su questi temi, perché ciò che conta di più è un atteggiamento proattivo, tanta curiosità e il forte desiderio di far parte di un gruppo internazionale! Sono apprezzati in particolar modo coloro che amano il lavoro di squadra, l'organizzazione d'attività e il contribuire con nuove idee. L'ideale sarebbe avessi già competenze comunicative, di scrittura e organizzazione di progetti giovanili, e anche digitali. Invece è necessario possedere un livello intermedio d'Inglese, per comunicare con il gruppo di lavoro e i partners internazionali. Se sei una persona dinamica, aperta, creativa, responsabile e amichevole, desiderosa di crescere sia personalmente che professionalmente in un ambiente internazionale e miulticulturale, questo è il volontariato giusto per te! Cosa aspetti a candidarti? Però ricorda che tutto il materiale che metti a disposizione a supporto della tua candidatura dev'essere in Inglese (o in Portoghese, se già lo parli....).

L'organizzazione d'accoglienza offre alloggi e spazi di lavoro per adulti con disabilità intellettiva. L'obiettivo è creare un ambiente di vita che consenta ai beneficiari di condurre una vita il più possibile indipendente e normale nonostante le loro difficoltà, adattando ogni attività alle loro capacità e limiti. Il tuo contributo sarà rilevante soprattutto nei programmi per il tempo libero, consentendo ai beneficiari di fare un numero maggiore d'escursioni, attività sportive, shopping individuale o altro che altrimenti non sarebbero possibili. Passeggiate, giochi e giardinaggio s'alterneranno ad attività come l'aiuto durante la cena e la toilette serale degli ospiti. Svilupperai poi tuoi progetti personali che s'aggiungeranno alle attività già messe in cantiere dalla residenza Sankt Martin. Il volontariato si realizzerà per lo più nel pomeriggio e nella prima serata, e una buona parte si svolgerà nei fine settimana, per cui i tuoi giorni liberi saranno in mezzo alla settimana.

Anche tu vivrai all'interno della residenza Sankt Martin, in una tua stanza singola, e riceverai e condividerai i pasti con lo staff della struttura e i beneficiari. Oltre a questi vantaggi, riceverai un'indennità per le tue spese personali che in Austria è di 7 euro al giorno. Il viaggio d'andata e ritorno dall'Italia all'Austria ti sarà totalmente rimborsato. Un'assicurazione convenzionata con l'Unione Europea ti coprirà in caso d'infortuni o malattie.

Parteciperai a 3 sessioni di formazione ufficiali: una prima della partenza dall'Italia, una seconda qualche settimana dopo il tuo arrivo in Austria e una terza verso la fine del volontariato. Sarà un'esperienza molto immersiva che ti permetterà di sviluppare competenze ed esperienze necessarie a inserirti professionalmente nel mondo dei servizi alla persona, e in particolare a quelli rivolti agli anziani e a soggetti con capacità ridotte che sarà così importante nell'immediato futuro. Inoltre riceverai un corso di Tedesco, lingua importante, difficile e non così largamente conosciuta.

Poiché questo progetto si occupa di persone disabili, è necessario essere più che disponibili, e anzi proprio interessati a lavorare con loro. Possedere una mentalità aperta ti aiuterà a venire a capo d'ogni situazione di difficoltà. Devi essere molto orientato professionalmente perché l'esperienza è intensa e profonda, in contatto quasi permanente con la struttura, il suo staff e i suoi beneficiari. Se stai pensando di candidarti, osserva anche bene le date d'inizio e fine del progetto, che sono precise e molto distanti nel tempo: procedi con la presentazione del tuo profilo solo se davvero sei intenzionato a svolgere un periodo di volontariato che non inizia prima di maggio 2026! E ricorda che tutto il materiale che metti a disposizione per supportare la tua candidatura dev'essere in Inglese (o in Tedesco, se già lo parli.....).

Stranaidea, ente di invio italiano, propone per l’ente ospitante SNJ questo progetto che offre ai giovani adulti (16-30), attualmente non impegnati nell'istruzione o nella formazione, l'opportunità di sviluppare competenze e rimanere attivi. I partecipanti possono sviluppare abilità di cucito e cucina. La filosofia principale del workshop è quella di riciclare i materiali donati, dando loro una seconda vita. Due designer lavorano con i giovani insegnando loro diverse tecniche e aiutandoli a realizzare progetti in autonomia. Un assistente sociale supporta i giovani nella loro vita quotidiana e fornisce loro consigli, incoraggiandoli a raggiungere i loro obiettivi futuri nell'istruzione o nel mercato del lavoro. Il volontario farà parte del team e parteciperà a tutti gli aspetti del workshop, tra cui fare amicizia con i partecipanti, partecipare alla creazione artigianale, rifinire i tessuti, aggiornare Instagram e preparare i pasti.

Alloggio: Alloggio condiviso con altri volontari internazionali e studenti lussemburghesi. Camere da letto singole con cucina e bagni in comune (completamente attrezzati e arredati). Cibo: Cuciniamo insieme il pranzo nell'atelier durante la settimana. Il volontario può suggerire e cucinare i pasti. Le preferenze alimentari possono essere soddisfatte. I volontari ricevono una paghetta mensile e un rimborso spese per il cibo. Trasporti: Accesso ai mezzi pubblici tra l'alloggio e l'atelier. Tutti i trasporti pubblici in Lussemburgo sono gratuiti. Avrete accesso a biciclette e auto condivise.

Il volontario acquisirà esperienza pratica nel lavoro sociale, in particolare nel lavoro con i giovani, e avrà la possibilità di apprendere diversi concetti e teorie, con particolare attenzione alle esigenze dei giovani in una situazione NEET e a come reagire in un contesto professionale. Il volontario potrà sviluppare competenze di cucito e finitura tessile, nonché abilità culinarie. È possibile frequentare corsi di lingua francese, tedesca e/o lussemburghese, oltre ad altri corsi pertinenti. SNJ organizza attività che permettono di scoprire il Lussemburgo e di fare networking.

Si ricerca un volontario entusiasta di lavorare con i giovani adulti. È richiesta esperienza pregressa nel lavoro sociale e/o nell'educazione non formale. Le attività quotidiane si svolgono in tedesco. Conoscere un po' di inglese o francese è un grande vantaggio per stabilire relazioni con i partecipanti. La conoscenza di programmi di grafica come Adobe Creative Cloud o simili per la finitura tessile è preferibile. La conoscenza del cucito (a macchina) è preferibile. È gradita esperienza con i social media, in particolare Instagram. Il volontario è disponibile a partecipare ad attività sportive.

Depuis 2015, France Volontaires renforce son action pour l’environnement au Congo via la mise en réseau d’associations, l’appui aux initiatives locales et l’organisation du Forestival, qui a déjà sensibilisé près de 1000 jeunes. Dans la continuité du projet FOREST et du programme « Volontaires pour la préservation des forêts », le/la volontaire contribuera à l’éducation et à la sensibilisation du grand public, notamment des jeunes, aux enjeux environnementaux et de développement durable.

Missions principales : concevoir des supports d’animation, organiser des séances de sensibilisation dans écoles, communautés et associations, coordonner ateliers, forums et formations, produire des supports audiovisuels et animer des campagnes de communication (radio, TV, réseaux sociaux). 

Le/la volontaire pilotera également des activités innovantes : projections, spectacles, sorties pédagogiques, jeux éducatifs autour de l’environnement et de la préservation des forêts.

Mission basée à Brazzaville, à partir d'octobre 2025, sous la responsabilité du Représentant National. 
Contrat de Volontariat de Solidarité Internationale avec indemnisation mensuelle, prise en charge du billet d’avion A/R, du visa et de la couverture sociale et médicale.
Logement équipé pris en charge et forfait transport prévus. 
Bureau et matériel de travail mis à disposition. 
Stage de préparation avant départ + phase d’accueil à l’arrivée. 
Déplacements possibles dans d’autres localités du Congo selon les besoins.

Nibble Stiftelsen runs different operations and activities. A central factor is the “Järna Naturbruks-gymnasium”. This is a 3 year high school offering a training program for green professions. Students participate in practical work in all areas. An important part of the school is the boarding school. The school/farm staff are international, with 7 countries represented. Nibble Farm is situated on the banks of the Baltic in a beautiful landscape. Activities at Nibble include, among others: -Nibble Handelsträdgård, a market garden and small holding with three hectares of fields, animals as well as green houses and shops. -Nibble Skog and Såg, forestry and a small scale saw mill. At Nibble we practice reality-based farming, gardening and more. We do this in the context of a training and education program. We collaborate with other local organisations and businesses with the goal of strengthening the local community and its resilience in a time of dramatic changes.

Volunteers will have their own room in a special two room appartment on the farm. 3 meals a day are served weekdays during the school year. Volunteers will have access to their own kitchen for weekends and school holidays. Food is available from on site stocks, the farmshop and an allowance for purchases in town. Bicycles are provided and there is easy access to public transport (Stockholm appr 1,5 hrs). A car is available for special cases.

Training will largely take place in the context of the practical work in which the volunteers participate. Weekly and daily meetings with the responsible on site will have a focus on learning and understanding. Taking part in the daily life on the farm, garden, with the animals and not least the boarding school will hopefully enable them to see the complexity of life and nature but also how everything within a farm organism is interrelated. Volunteers will be given the opportunity to participate in courses both on and off the site.

Volunteers at Nibble should have an interest in agriculture (and related areas), environmental and social educational issues. Any experience in practical work, especially in green professions is a definite plus but not necessary, Volonteers should be open, curious and willing to do practical work, even in uncomfortable situations. Willingness to listen and learn from more experienced people is a plus. An interest in working with teenagers is important. Some flexibility is good, many people and activities can lead to plans being changed. A basic command of English is important.

The volunteering experience focuses on the care and accompaniment of children living in situations of high social vulnerability. Volunteers actively participate in educational support, recreational activities, and community spaces, offering a safe and nurturing environment where children can grow and develop. Their role involves providing close attention, accompanying daily routines, fostering integration among peers, and promoting values of respect, solidarity, and autonomy. Through playful, educational, and artistic dynamics, volunteers support both emotional well-being and learning, serving as positive role models and a source of support in times of difficulty. This close involvement becomes a bridge towards experiences of trust and care, essential to counteract exclusion and to open future opportunities for each child.

Volunteers are hosted in a shared house located within the organization’s center. Rooms are shared with other volunteer, fostering community life and intercultural exchange. Breakfast and lunch are provided collectively during the week, while volunteers are responsible for preparing their own dinners and weekend meals. Local transport is covered for activities related to the project, while personal expenses remain the responsibility of each volunteer.

Volunteers will receive continuous learning opportunities through non-formal education activities and regular mentoring. They will be introduced to the organization’s work with children in vulnerable situations and guided step by step in their daily tasks. Weekly reflection meetings and intercultural exchanges with other volunteers support personal and professional growth. Participation in local and European programs also provides new skills, perspectives, and knowledge useful for their future paths.

We are looking for motivated volunteers who are open, empathetic, and responsible, with a genuine interest in accompanying children and young people living in situations of social vulnerability. Previous experience in childcare, education, or community work is welcome but not mandatory. More important are patience, creativity, willingness to learn, and the ability to work in a team. Volunteers should be flexible, respectful of diversity, and ready to adapt to a collective lifestyle. A basic level of English or Spanish is required to ensure communication, integration, and participation in daily activities.

Formação específica mediante a alocação dos voluntários às atividades. Antes da integração do voluntário em cada atividade, este será capacitado para o trabalho a desenvolver.

However, the staff of Spolek Hvozd will provide every volunteer with full support in order to ensure that the volunteer overcomes all kinds of difficulties. In the end volunteer organize his working day and cooperate with others.

Since 1995, ENGIM has operated in Albania in partnership with Qendra Sociale Murialdo, promoting vocational training, youth integration, social inclusion, child protection, and the fight against domestic violence. Within this project, ENGIM works in Fier reaching  vulnerable groups, including Roma children, children with disabilities, youth from disadvantaged areas, participants in vocational training, and around 2,000 individuals reached through awareness campaigns.
Volunteer responsibilities: Provide educational and social support to vulnerable children and youth. Assist in organizing artistic, recreational, and sports activities. Access to training resources for continuous learning.

full_description:
This program revolves around soil regeneration via permaculture and syntropic agroforestry techniques. We are reviving 30 hectares of degraded land to serve as a model for eco living and provide ways to ensure food and water security for the current and the next generation by implementing innovative planting techniques such as Syntropic agriculture.

This agroforestry technique advocates cooperation in nature as opposed to competition and highlights the role of diversity in creating a healthy ecosystem. The site is being transformed into a public park filled with biodiversity and a green playground for hosting our yearly music and art festival. You will be participating in various activities such as creating and maintaining agroforestry systems, organic gardening, regenerative landscaping. You will also take part of cultural and community events such as listening sessions, collective cooking, local market or other events for the local community.

ACCOMMODATION
Tipis with electricity and beds, located around the Lake. In the fall and winter, we have a heated house (with kitchen, living room, bathrooms) in the village. 

FACILITIES 
Showers with warm water and compost toilets. 
Filtered drinking water Washing machine.

FOOD 
Three meals a day are cooked with food sourced as much as possible from our own garden and local producers. 
Free drinking water, coffee, plant-based milk and various teas are available 24/7. 

TRANSPORT 
Daily bus and train to Lisbon and Porto.
Car sharing is facilitated.
Bicycles available for use.

You will join a team of passionates taking you on a deep dive into reviving barren land through alternative agroforestry technics. You will learn about: 
- rewilding, renaturation of streams
- agroforestry technics
- hydration of the landscape, water security
- the design and set-up of a small scale organic farming and food-processing model to achieve self-sufficiency and food sovereignty in order to sustain the onsite community during the year
- rural social landscape
- community living dynamics
- community care

We will provide english language support if needed.

Interested in learning about plants and building vibrant ecosystems?
Not afraid to get your hands dirty and melt your sweat with soil? 
Ready to join a big community of beings living, working and celebrating together?

That sounds like your cup of t(r)ea!

Curious mind and committed physical condition is highly recommended 🙂

Je ti mezi 18–30 lety a chceš strávit 9 měsíců v malebné Gruzii? V rámci Evropského sboru solidarity (ESC) máš jedinečnou příležitost zúčastnit se dlouhodobého dobrovolnického projektu v Ozurgeti, kde budeš podporovat místní komunitu a mládež prostřednictvím vzdělávacích a kulturních aktivit.
Náplň práce
Jako dobrovolník se budeš podílet na různých aktivitách, včetně přípravy workshopů pro mládež, podpory místních komunitních iniciativ, organizování kulturních a sportovních akcí a koordinace mezinárodních dobrovolnických skupin. Budeš také pomáhat s komunikací a vytvářením propagačních materiálů pro různé projekty.
Informace o Ozurgeti: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ozurgeti
Krátký videoklip o Ozurgeti: https://cutt.ly/Be48Fxf1
Krátký videoklip o regionu - Guria: https://cutt.ly/ce48FS29
Web hostitelské organizace Student Youth Council: https://www.syc.ge/index.php/eng

Projekt začíná dle domluvy v dubnu, případně květnu, a trvá 273 dní + maximálně 2 dny na cestu tam i zpět.

ESC projekt pokryje ubytování a stravu, cestovní náklady na projekt i zpět, pojištění, kapesné, jazykovou podporu.
Ozurgeti je malé město, nenajdeš zde noční kluby ani diskotéky, ale…
Budeš mít příležitost zažít autentickou gruzínskou kulturu a pohostinnost, daleko za hranicemi typického "turistického" zážitku. Ozurgeti se nachází na jedinečném místě: pouhých 25 km od pobřeží Černého moře, horské letovisko Bakhmaro je vzdáleno jen 45 km a turecká hranice 75 km. Tvoje pomoc místní komunitě zde bude viditelnější a více ceněná než v městských oblastech.

Jazyková podpora: Pro dobrovolníky bude zajištěn 12hodinový základní kurz gruzínského jazyka.
Dobrovolníci se zúčastní školení on-arrival a mid-term, která zajišťuje organizace SALTO EECA.
Budou se moct účastnit různých workshopů (taneční, kulinářský, kulturní...)

Co požadujeme?
Zájem o práci s mládeží a neformální vzdělávání.
Schopnost pracovat v multikulturním prostředí.
Kreativitu, ochotu učit se a sdílet své dovednosti.
Zájem o interkulturní a mezigenerační učení a dialog a ochotu vypořádat se s výzvami, které přináší.

Tento projekt ti poskytne jedinečnou příležitost získat cenné zkušenosti v oblasti práce s mládeží a neformálního vzdělávání. Těšíme se na tvoji přihlášku!

Sarai inserito in uno dei programmi di danza comunitaria più importanti e duraturi dell'Europa, i cui partecipanti hanno l'opportunità di sviluppare il proprio potenziale creativo attraverso il coinvolgimento in processi artistici. La pratica del movimento nel tempo e nello spazio funge da strumento per promuovere l'inclusione sociale e il contrasto ai pregiudizi, fornendo un incentivo ad affrontare attivamente gli attuali difficili eventi socio-politici. In base ai tuoi interessi, capacità e competenze, sono disponibili diversi campi d'azione, come il supporto nella pianificazione di progetti di danza locali e internazionali, l'assistenza durante laboratori e prove di danza, il marketing rivolto a gruppi svantaggiati, la documentazione fotografica e video, il supporto nelle attività tecniche durante la preparazione degli spettacoli e la cura dei social media. Potresti essere coinvolto anche in altre iniziative solidali realizzate nel quartiere, e anche presentare tue idee e proposte.

Alloggerai in stanza singola, in un appartamento o in uno studentato: non sarà lussuosa, ma soddisferà le tue esigenze di base. Tuttavia potrebbe non esserci internet. Riceverai un'indennità per le tue spese personali che in Austria è di 7 euro al giorno. Il vitto ti sarà fornito dall'organizzazione d'accoglienza, oppure riceverai a questo scopo una seconda indennità mensile fino a 250 euro. Il viaggio d'andata e ritorno dall'Italia all'Austria ti sarà totalmente rimborsato, e riceverai un abbonamento mensile  valido per tutti i trasporti pubblici locali. È anche prevista un'assicurazione.

Parteciperai a 3 sessioni di formazione ufficiali: una prima della partenza dall'Italia, una seconda qualche settimana dopo il tuo arrivo in Austria e una terza verso la fine del volontariato. Riceverai un supporto economico per frequentare un corso di Tedesco a tua scelta. Sarà un'esperienza bellissima che ti permetterà di sviluppare tante competenze diverse, sia nell'àmbito strettamente artistico correlato alla danza e all'allestimento di spettacoli ed eventi rivolti al pubblico, sia nel campo dell'integrazione comunitaria che del lavoro sociale con realtà vulnerabili.

Il nostro volontario ideale è molto interessato ai temi della danza partecipativa come strumento d'inclusione sociale. Devi essere motivato a sostenere il progetto attraverso documentazione fotografica e video delle varie attività, usando in modo creativo i social media per supportarne la visibilità. Sei un giovane aperto a incontrare nuove persone, interagire con estranei e costruire relazioni sia con i partecipanti ai programmi di danza che con i membri dello staff. Ci aspettiamo che tu abbia buone capacità comunicative, spirito di squadra, una mentalità aperta e l'abilità d'integrare le tue attuali competenze con uno o più dei numerosi e vari cómpiti da svolgere nel progetto. Se stai pensando di candidarti, osserva bene le date d'inizio e fine del progetto, che sono precise e molto distanti nel tempo: procedi con la presentazione del tuo profilo solo se davvero sei intenzionato a svolgere un periodo di volontariato che non inizia prima di maggio 2026! E ricorda che tutto il materiale che metti a disposizione per supportare la tua candidatura dev'essere in Inglese (o in Tedesco, se lo parli.....).

Alianza por la Solidaridad, a member of ActionAid, works to promote active citizenship, fight inequalities, and advance human rights through development cooperation and education projects. We focus on gender-based violence, migrants' rights, and climate justice. Join us in Kolda as Assistant Project Officer with Admin & Finance support! In this role, you'll support the overall management of project activities, working closely with the financial team on tasks such as preparing project and office budgets, financial monitoring, and activity justification. You'll also assist in handling relevant financial documents, contribute to financial reporting, and support audits. This opportunity will provide hands-on experience in both project management and financial tasks within development cooperation and humanitarian aid, helping you develop skills that are essential for future work in the sector.

You will have the opportunity to live with other volunteers but with individual bedroom. The accommodation costs and utility bills will be covered by the organization andphone card will be provided. The house will be located in Kolda. You will receive a monthly allowance of 479,72€ for your personal expenses, including food and local transport. For the activities of Alianza, a vehicle will be provided. You will also be covered with a health insurance (Henner).

You will receive training which will cover topics such as: induction to Alianza por la Solidaridad, induction to the European Solidarity Corps, responsibilities and rights of the organisations and of the volunteer, Youthpass, Henner insurance and SHEA. In addition you will be trained more specifically in feminist leadership and rules on monitoring and financial justification. In the end of your volunteering, you will know how to work in a multidisciplinary team, both on the field and in the office, as well as the justification procedures of each Spanish funder and how to create budgets.

We are looking for a person eager to learn and work in a team and able to adapt to the context. Interest in developing skills in administration and finance. Motivation to be on the field to work closely between the implementation of activities and economic justification. Studies and any experience in economic monitoring, accounting, or administration, as well as French language skills, will be an asset. If you are migrant, live in rural areas, have limited economic support or any other don´t hesitate to sign up, this opportunity is for everyone!

Key tasks:
Support in the preparation of monthly financial statements
Collaboration in the preparation of monthly tax declarations
Assistance in recording banking and accounting transactions
Support in managing supplier payments
Preparation and filing of administrative documentation
Support in the preparation of administrative and financial reports
Updating and maintaining accounting records
Collaboration with the team to optimize administrative processes
Assistance in internal audit activities and support in coordination with other departments

- Volunteers will be accommodated in a shared apartment or guesthouse in a community near the project area. Basic utilities such as electricity, water, and internet access will be available, though service may be intermittent due to contingencies.

We are looking for vets and vet nurses who will work for our stray cats and dogs in Sinop, Turkiye for a short term (2 months). Working locations: Sinop shelters, Gerze shelter, wildlife center, the village where our cats and dogs are and the volunteers' house where there are the ones which need long treatments. In the shelters and in the wildlife center, the volunteers will assist the employed vets and the staff with their work such as treatment, surgery, check-ups, hygiene and keeping the record of the stages of the treatment. Feeding the orphans (hand rearing), sick and elderly will be the tasks of the volunteer. In the village, the volunteers will feed, clean and check-up the animals, and take the dogs for a walk. Going to rescue operations and city tours to feed stray animals are among the tasks of the volunteers. Volunteers will work in shifts so that each volunteer will go to every location every week. Two days off in a week.

The travel costs will be reimbursed according to the program guidelines. The volunteers will live in a furnished flat. Short term volunteers might share their rooms. The shelter car will pick the volunteers and bring them back for the Sinop shelters. For the Gerze shelter and the village, volunteers will take the bus. We pay the bus cost monthly. For the wildlife center, the volunteers will go to the main office in the city center and their car will take them to the center and back. The volunteers will get 360 Euros for food and pocket money per month.

The volunteer will learn the following: - The first aid for cats and dogs - Cat and dog sterilization (male and female) - Diagnosis and treatment in internal medicine - Traumatic surgery and amputation - Post-op care - Distemper, Panleukopenia and Parvoviral Enteritis treatment - Nursing the orphans (hand rearing)- Daily check-up of the patients and babies - Cooking especially for the babies and the patients and feeding them.

We are looking for a vet, vet student, vet nurse or vet nurse student. Volunteers should be passionate with their work and eager to develop their competences. Also able to live and work with other volunteers from diverse nationalities.

International Projects - Chemnitz

Are you ready to be part of an exciting adventure? 🌍✨ We’re looking for creative minds to help us plan programs and excursions for our Erasmus+ groups! Our participants are aged between 16 and 28, along with some awesome teachers.

Whether you want to join us for a short time or stay long-term, we have a spot for you until  31.12.2026 ! And hey, there might even be opportunities to work on Saturdays.

Bring your ideas and let’s create unforgettable experiences together! 🎉

- Stay in cozy hostels or flats with self-catering options. 🏡
- We’ve got you covered with airport transfers to and from your accommodation. ✈️
- Enjoy regional transport for all your adventures! 🚍
- Help us organize awesome seminars and weekend activities. 🎉
- Get language support to make communication a breeze! 🗣️
- Plus, we offer pocket money and meal allowances to keep you fueled! 💰🍽️

Depending on the activity, you can participate in internal training sessions, and the accompanying seminars count towards this as well.

-Embrace intercultural understanding and be friendly! 😊
-Enjoy working with international groups (ages 16-28 and teachers).
-English is a must; German isn’t required.
-Collaborate in teams, stay motivated, and be self-organized.
-Take personal responsibility for your tasks!

City of Chemnitz - Work in the City administration, in the European Capital of Culture 2025 

Take part in topics like: 
- European Projects 
- Cross-border collaboration
- EU initiatives 
- civic involvement and participation 
- culture 
- twin towns 
- municipal networks 
- diplomatic and protocol work 
- Events 
- Event management

- Accomodation in Chemnitz/ Saxony/Germany - hostel/flats
- Self care board 
- transfer from the airport to the hostel and back, 
- regional transfer
- Organizing from seminars,
- weekend acitivities,
- language support 
- payment of pocket money and board money

Sadly not in the usual way, but you will learn a lot about working in a City, working on big City projects and also international work in the public service.

We’re looking for passionate volunteers who love bringing creative projects to life! If you’ve got skills in communication, event organizing, or production—awesome! Knowledge of social media or graphic design? Even better!
- Embrace intercultural understanding and be friendly! 😊
- Collaborate in teams, stay motivated, and be self-organized.
- Take personal responsibility for your tasks!

Supported by ICE-RF, "Les Amis de Jéricho" of Toulon wants to host volunteers in its structure. This experience will give the opportunity to the volunteer to get engaged in a project, to contribute to his/her French level, give him/her autonomy and independence, a maturity in her/his personal and professional life.

 Amis de Jéricho is an association that deals with people from the street, prison, hospital, with social and professional difficulties. It wants to help to the reintegration of these people. With its four sites, it may offers, in addition to its missions, workshops, focus groups and cultural activities. Administrative assistance is also offered so that people in difficulties can find training or an accommodation.

The volunteer will live in a shared apartment with other volunteers not far from Toulon with a kitchen, a bathroom and with his own bed room.
 He can eat at the organisation but he will also get money.
 French language courses will be provided through the online linguistic support

The volunteer will take part at trainings organised by the National Agency.
 Before the beginning of the voluntary, in august 2019, he has to take part on a 2.5 weeks preparation, which included french courses, administrative tasks and many other interesting activities. This seminar is good to meet other volunteers. It's organised by the coordinating organisation ICE-RF.
 2 months and 8 months after the beginning the volunteer is invited to take part on another seminars organised by ICE-RF.

The volunteer should share the basic values that inspires our work as the respect for the people.
 He has to be openminded and supportive, creative and motivated : a part of people coming at “les Amis de Jéricho’’ needs help to be motivated to build up a new life, even a new activity…
Driving license is welcome.

Hotels School of the Canary Islands (HECANSA) is a company attached to the Ministry of Tourism and Employment of the Government of  the  Canary Islands that oﬀers Dual Vocational Training, with hotel establishments and restaurants that oﬀer a real learning escenario. We allow students to train through the acquisition of theoretical and practical knowledge, applied from the ﬁrst day with clients and in real scenarios.

The volunteers will be living in the student´s residence of our Hotel Schools and will have all the menus included in the hotel.

ESC@HECANSA 2025 will be held mainly in our 2 main buildings, the Hotel Escuela Santa Brígida (Gran Canaria) and the Hotel Escuela Santa Cruz (Tenerife). 
Volunteers will help in various departments of the hotel-school (housekeeping, Food and Beverage department, reception, reservations, revenue, hotel management, events, etc) to understand the hotel and the tourism sector. Adicionally, the volunters will assist the educational department wuth language classes organizing speaking lessons using non-formal aducation methods.

We are looking for volunteers from European Union countries who have training or experience in the hospitality and tourism sector, or who, even without this background, show a high level of motivation to develop in this area.

A minimum B1 level of Spanish (spoken and written) is required.

This is a unique opportunity to gain valuable experience, contribute to meaningful projects, and be part of an international environment in the tourism industry.

🚀 Ready for your next adventure with the European Solidarity Corps? In 2026, we start ”Year 5” of our long-term mission — and you can be part of it!
Join us in Baia Mare, Romania and volunteer in activities like: run creative workshops for youth, blog & do digital content, explore nature, support local NGOs, and connect with inspiring people.

Volunteers tasks: Developing skills needed for young people in the upcoming European job market by: creating activities and workshops on writing CVs and motivation letters, role play interviews, workshops on digital skills, cybersecurity, fake news and other activities meant to boost the DIGITAL employability skills of youth from the local community. 

Grow your skills, make a real impact, and live an unforgettable experience with like-minded young changemakers. You can choose a shorter project (up to 2 months) a standard one of 4 months or an even longer one!
Let’s build something meaningful together. Romania is calling... are you in? 💬

🏠 Accommodation: Live in shared flats with WiFi, furniture & all essentials. Utilities are covered by volunteers. You’ll receive €150/month for food.

✈️ Travel: We reimburse local & international travel (within a set limit). Choose eco-friendly transport for extra support!

💰 Pocket Money: Get €4/day to help with personal expenses.

📌 Requirements: Follow ESC rules, our values, and internal guidelines to make the most of your experience.

Support & Training:
🧩 We’ve got you covered with activity support, language lessons, and non-formal education workshops — all focused on learning by doing and active involvement.

🌍 Sending Organization: You’ll also have guidance from a support team in your home country before and during the project.

⚠️ Important: This isn’t a job or a vacation. We're looking for volunteers driven by growth, cultural exchange, and making a real impact in the community.

Who We're Looking For:
🎯 Open-minded, positive, and communicative
🎯 Able to plan & lead activities
 🎯 Comfortable working with young people
🎯 Aged 18–30, motivated & ready to grow
🎯 EU citizens preferred
🎯 Speak English & open to learning Romanian
🎯 Passionate about cultural exchange & social impact
🎯 Committed to long-term community work
🎯 Eager to learn & develop new skills
💫 All backgrounds are welcome!

There are several opportunities that you can choose from volunteering in the leisure time center in Náchod, in Hronov, volunteering in local schools, volunteering in Montessori school, volunteering in Montessori-style kindergarten.
The main target group you will work with will be children aged 3 to 18, but you can also partly help with activities for adults. During the summer you will help with the summer camps that we organize for children from 3 to 13 years old. The experience you will get is really wide, intensive and life-changing. The duration of the project is 1st of Septemberl of 2025 until 31st of January 2026. However, you can also stay in the project from beggining of January 2026 till the end of August 2026.

The tickets you will buy for the journey for the project and back home will be reimbursed. You don´t have to pay for accommodation, it is fully funded from the project. Moreover, you will recieve mohtly pocket money to buy your own food and personal things.
You will live in a shared apartment with your own room. The apartment is fully equipped.
You will not have to travel daily to the organization, you will live in the same town close to the organization´s seat.
Náchod is a small town - however it has many shops, sport facilities, a cinema, cafés, restaurants and bars.

You will get an opportunity to join the training called On-arrival which is organized by the National agency. Another training will consist of a team building 3-days long meeting of volunteers from the whole project on the organization´s camp base, where all the volunteering matters will be explained to you. During your volunteering you will be under leading of the coordinator and pedagogue, who will help you with all the steps at the beginning - in case that you cannot prepare the activity fully by yourself, we will be helpful.

We expect that you are an open-minded, responsible and flexible person who is interested in pedagogy and enjoys working with children. The age of the candidate must be between 18 and 30 years old.
We want to be sure that you understand the term VOLUNTEERING and that you don´t take the project as a thing that only you should benefit from.
You don´t have to have any special qualifications to apply for this project. We will teach you everything. It will be helpful if you speak at least a little bit of English so the communication can be easier.

The Courteline association develops activities and services around three axes: social action, educational action and cultural action. The volunteer will be integrated into the family animation team. As such the volunteer will participate into parent-child entertainment during school vacation periods (creative workshops, cooking, music, cultural discoveries...). He will take part in recreational outings (cinema, walks, sport activities...), in family outing (3 outings per year in leisure parks, cultural visits...), and in school support for children. The volunteer will also help to run workshops on gender equality and the fight against all forms of discrimination. He/she will also be involved in running the child and parent drop-in centre, which helps to socialise very young children, and the local library. Artistic skills and an awareness of gender equality would be a plus for this role. The volunteer will work with a multidisciplinary team.

The accommodation will be provided for the volunteer, a single room in a shared apartment. Volunteer receive pocket money , a food allowance , and all costs associated with the mission (public transportation, bike...) will be covered.

CHECK THE INFOPACK :) Join our team of 21 volunteers and spend ten exciting months in our ESC project! More information on www.esc.polites.org.pl. POLITES Association is organizing a long-term individual volunteering project that will take place in Szczecin, Poland. Volunteers can either work in the kindergarten or office. It will last from Sept 25 to July 26. The aim of the project is to develop your key competences and gain life experience. Taking part in our project means working with kids, the youth and the local community. You will have a great chance to present yourself, your country and culture. Also, you will participate in different workshops and activities. During these ten months, you will be presenting your culture, country, ideas, and the creative approach towards many actions. More information on our website - contact us for more and fill in our application form here: www.esc.polites.org.pl. Apply here to get more information as well. See you soon!

* shared flat with other volunteers, single rooms (fully equipped with basic appliances, up to 6 people per flat)

A 2 hónapos önkéntességre a Salva Vita Alapítvány székhelyén a Szeglet Közösségi és Élménytérben kerül sor.
Az önkéntességi program célja elsősorban, hogy speciális igényű fiatalok az önálló felnőtt élettel kapcsolatos tapasztalatot szerezzenek. Továbbá, hogy személyes fejlődésen menjenek keresztül, önbizalmat és önállóságot építsenek, új készségeket sajátítsanak el (pl. adminisztratív, szervezési, kommunikációs), szociális kapcsolatokat alakítsanak ki, és megtapasztalják a közösséghez való aktív hozzájárulás élményét. Ezen túl célunk, hogy szakmai tapasztalatokat szerezzenek irodai környezetben, amelyek elősegítik munkaerőpiaci esélyeiket, felfedezzék saját erősségeiket és kompetenciáikat, amelyeket a Youthpass-ban is dokumentálhatnak.
Az egyéni önkénteseknek egyéni mentort biztosítunk, aki kiadja a feladatot, ellenőrizte a feladatok elvégzését, és akihez egyéb ügyekben is fordulhattak.

A fiatalok az önkéntes szerződés alapján részesülnek támogatásba. Ez elsősorban közlekedési támogatás, étkezési támogatás és zsebpénz (7 EUR/fő/nap).
Az önkéntesek belföldi fiatalok, Budapesten illetve annak vonzáskörzetéből érkeznek, így szállás biztosítására nem lesz szükségük, saját otthonunkban szállnak meg.

Tapasztalat szerzés önkéntességgel irodai környezetben.

A programra magyar, speciális igényű (pl. fogyatékkal élő vagy neurodiverz) 18-30 éves fiatalokat várunk, akik Budapesten vagy annak vonzáskörzetében élnek, laknak.

Τέλος, θα συμβάλλουν στην λειτουργία πολύγλωσσης δανειστικής βιβλιοθήκης.
